title.en: Money over time: interest, repayment and the economy

modules.passageTitle: 足し算で増えるお金、掛け算で増えるお金 — 祖父の帳簿から

cards.g: public finance; (an organization's or household's) finances
cards.d: 国や自治体が、税などのお金を集めて使うしくみと、そのやりくり。
s: 国の財政支援を受けて駅前の再開発が始まり、町に人が戻ってきた。
財政
With financial support from the national government, redevelopment began around the station, and people came back to the town.
うちの家計は今月も財政難で、外食はしばらくお預けだ。
財政
Our household is in a 'fiscal crisis' again this month, so eating out is on hold for a while.
cf: 財務 is an organization's financial affairs and accounting (財務部, 財務諸表, 財務省); 財政 is above all government finance.
cards.note: Core sense is government/public finance (財政赤字 = fiscal deficit). Applying it to a household (家計が財政難) is a mildly humorous stretch.

cards.g: funds; capital (money set aside for a purpose)
cards.d: ある目的のために用意しておく、まとまったお金。
s: それでも祖父は手元の資金を取り崩さず、仕入れを絞り、無駄な費えを一つずつ削っていった。
資金
Even so, my grandfather didn't dip into the funds he had on hand; he cut back on stock and trimmed wasteful expenses one by one.
留学の資金を貯めるため、彼女は週に四日アルバイトをしている。
資金
She works a part-time job four days a week to save up money for studying abroad.
cf: 資本 is capital as an economic or ownership concept (資本金, 資本主義); 資金 is actual money earmarked for a use.
cards.note: 資金繰り (cash-flow juggling) is a staple of small-business talk: 資金繰りが苦しい = struggling to make payments.

cards.g: yield; rate of return (on an investment)
cards.d: 投資したお金に対して、一年あたりどれだけもうけが出るかの割合。
s: 利回りは高くなかったが、それで十分だったという。
利回り
The yield wasn't high, but he says that was enough.
表面利回りが高い物件ほど、空室のリスクも疑ってかかったほうがいい。
利回り
The higher a property's headline yield, the more you should be suspicious about vacancy risk.
cf: 利率 is the fixed rate attached to a deposit, loan or bond coupon; 利回り is the overall annual return, including price gains or losses.
金利 is the general/market interest rate; in bond news 長期金利 is in fact the 10-year government bond 利回り.
cards.note: In bond reporting, 利回り moves opposite to price: 債券価格が下がると利回りは上がる.

cards.g: geometric (constant ratio), as in 等比数列 geometric sequence
cards.d: となり合うもの同士の比が、いつも同じであること。
s: 元金を初項、「1＋利率」を公比とする等比数列を考えれば、毎年の残高はそのまま表せる。
等比
If you think of it as a geometric sequence with the principal as the first term and (1 + rate) as the common ratio, you can express each year's balance directly.
等比級数の和の公式は、期末テストに必ずと言っていいほど出る。
等比
The formula for the sum of a geometric series shows up on almost every end-of-term exam.
cf: 等差 = constant difference (arithmetic): 等差数列 is an arithmetic sequence; 等比 = constant ratio (geometric).
cards.note: Rarely used on its own; you meet it almost only in 等比数列 and 等比級数. Ratio between consecutive terms is the 公比.

cards.d: 決まった順番で、数を一列に並べたもの。
s: 元金を初項、「1＋利率」を公比とする等比数列を考えれば、毎年の残高はそのまま表せる。
数列
If you think of it as a geometric sequence with the principal as the first term and (1 + rate) as the common ratio, you can express each year's balance directly.
この数列の次に来る数を当てるパズルが、ネットで話題になっている。
数列
A puzzle where you guess the next number in this sequence is going viral online.
cf: 級数 = series, i.e. the sum of a sequence's terms; 数列 = the ordered list itself.

cards.d: 借りたお金を、貸してくれた相手に返すこと。
s: 店を改装したときの借入金の返済には、ずいぶん苦労したらしい。
返済
Apparently he had a really hard time repaying the loan he took out when he renovated the shop.
奨学金の返済が終わるまで、あと五年かかる。
返済
It'll take another five years until I finish paying back my student loans.
cf: 返却 is returning a borrowed object (library books, rentals); 返済 is for money and debts.
返金 = a refund paid back to a customer; 返済 = paying off what you owe.
cards.note: Source gloss lists 'refund'; in modern use a refund is 返金, not 返済.

cards.d: 銀行などにお金を預けること。また、そのお金。
s: 祖父はまた、どんなに苦しい年でも少しずつ預金を続けていた。
預金
My grandfather also kept putting a little money in the bank, no matter how hard the year.
給料日の翌日、残ったお金を全部定期預金に回した。
預金
The day after payday, I moved all the leftover money into a time deposit.
cf: 貯金 is the everyday word for savings (even a piggy bank); 預金 is specifically money held by a bank, more formal.

cards.d: お金を貸し借りするとき、もとのお金に対してつく利息の割合。
s: 通帳を見ると当時の金利は今よりずっと高く、利息だけで年に数万円になる年もあった。
金利
His bankbook shows interest rates were much higher back then; some years the interest alone came to tens of thousands of yen.
日銀が政策金利を引き上げるとの見方から、住宅ローンの相談が増えている。
金利
With expectations that the Bank of Japan will raise its policy rate, inquiries about home loans are increasing.
cf: 利率 is the stated rate on a specific product; 金利 is the general/market rate and the everyday word.
利息 is the amount of money; 金利 is the rate (%).
cards.note: In everyday speech 金利 also stands loosely for the interest itself (金利が高いローン).

cards.g: interest rate (the stated rate of a particular loan or deposit)
cards.d: 元金に対して、利息がどれくらいつくかを表す割合。
s: 利率と時間が相乗的に効いてくるため、最初の数年はほとんど差がなくても、二十年、三十年と経つうちに両者の開きは歴然とする。
利率
Because the rate and time reinforce each other, even if there's barely a difference in the first few years, after twenty or thirty years the gap between the two becomes unmistakable.
この定期預金の利率は年〇・二パーセントと、ほとんど増えないに等しい。
利率
This time deposit pays 0.2% a year, which is practically the same as not growing at all.
cf: 金利 is the general/market rate; 利率 is the figure written on a specific contract or product.
利回り is the actual overall return on an investment; 利率 is the nominal rate.
cards.note: Common in contracts, textbooks and math problems; in conversation people usually just say 金利.

cards.d: 数を順番に並べたときの、いちばん最初の数。
s: 元金を初項、「1＋利率」を公比とする等比数列を考えれば、毎年の残高はそのまま表せる。
初項
If you think of it as a geometric sequence with the principal as the first term and (1 + rate) as the common ratio, you can express each year's balance directly.
初項が3、公差が2の等差数列の第10項を求めよ。
初項
Find the 10th term of the arithmetic sequence with first term 3 and common difference 2.
cf: 末項 = the last term of a finite sequence.
cards.note: Strictly a math-class word; 公比 (common ratio) and 公差 (common difference) are its usual partners.

cards.g: investing/managing (funds); putting into practice, operating (rules, systems)
cards.d: お金や制度などを、目的に合わせてうまく動かして使うこと。
s: 祖父は余裕のできた資金をすぐには使わず、元本割れの心配が少ない国債で地道に運用した。
運用
Rather than spend the spare money right away, my grandfather steadily invested it in government bonds, where there was little risk of losing the principal.
新しい在宅勤務のルールは、来月から試験的に運用される。
運用
The new work-from-home rules will be put into operation on a trial basis from next month.
cf: 運営 = running an organization or event; 運用 = putting money, rules or systems to practical use.
利用 = simply using something; 運用 implies managing it over time toward a goal.
cards.note: The 'steering a boat' sense in the source gloss is obsolete; you will meet 資産運用 and 制度の運用 constantly.

cards.g: interest (the money paid or earned on a loan or deposit)
cards.d: お金を借りたり預けたりしたとき、もとの額に上乗せされるお金。
s: 単利では、利息は最初に預けた元金にしかつかない。
利息
With simple interest, interest is earned only on the principal you first deposited.
友だちに貸した千円に利息をつけて返せなんて、冗談でも言えない。
利息
I couldn't tell a friend to pay back the thousand yen I lent them with interest, not even as a joke.
cf: 金利 is the rate (%); 利息 is the actual amount of money.
利子 is a near-synonym, a little more everyday; 利息 is the term in law (利息制限法) and bank statements.

cards.d: 利息がつく前の、最初に借りたり預けたりしたお金。
s: 毎月払っても大半が利息に消え、元金がなかなか減らない。
元金
Even paying every month, most of it goes to interest and the principal barely goes down.
元金均等返済なら、返すたびに残りの借金が同じ額ずつ減っていく。
元金
With equal-principal repayment, the remaining debt goes down by the same amount every time you pay.
cf: 元本 is the broader word for principal, esp. for investments (元本保証, 元本割れ); 元金 is typical for loans and deposits.
cards.note: Also read もときん, but がんきん is the standard reading in finance.

cards.d: 最初のお金だけをもとに、毎回同じ額の利息を計算するやり方。
s: そこで私は、高校の数学で習った単利と複利の違いを思い出した。
単利
That's when I remembered the difference between simple and compound interest that I'd learned in high-school math.
単利で年五パーセントなら、十年で増えるのはちょうど元金の半分だ。
単利
At 5% simple interest, what you gain in ten years is exactly half the principal.
cf: 複利 = compound interest: each period's interest is added to the principal.

cards.d: だれが見てもはっきりとわかるようす。
s: 利率と時間が相乗的に効いてくるため、最初の数年はほとんど差がなくても、二十年、三十年と経つうちに両者の開きは歴然とする。
歴然
Because the rate and time reinforce each other, even if there's barely a difference in the first few years, after twenty or thirty years the gap between the two becomes unmistakable.
プロとアマの実力差は、序盤の数手で歴然としていた。
歴然
The gap in strength between the pro and the amateur was obvious within the first few moves.
cf: 明白 = clearly established (facts, evidence, intent); 歴然 stresses that a difference is plain to see.
cards.note: Overwhelmingly used with 差, 違い, 証拠: 実力の差は歴然.

cards.d: 決まった数を、変数の回数だけ掛け合わせて値を出す関数。
s: 年数を変数とみれば、これは指数関数にほかならない。
指数関数
If you treat the number of years as the variable, this is nothing other than an exponential function.
感染者が指数関数的に増えていると、専門家は警鐘を鳴らした。
指数関数
Experts sounded the alarm that infections were rising exponentially.
cf: 対数関数 = logarithmic function, the inverse of 指数関数.
cards.note: 指数関数的に ('exponentially') is common in news and everyday talk, often loosely meaning 'very fast'.

cards.d: 数と数を合わせて、全部でいくつになるかを出す計算。
s: 毎年同じ額が加わるだけなので、計算は足し算の繰り返しにすぎない。
足し算
Since the same amount is added every year, the calculation is just repeated addition.
いいチームは足し算ではなく掛け算で強くなる、と監督は言った。
足し算
The manager said a good team gets stronger by multiplication, not addition.
cf: 加算 is the formal/technical word for addition (also 'surcharge', 加算料金); 足し算 is the everyday, school word.
cards.note: The 足し算 vs 掛け算 contrast is a popular figure of speech for linear vs synergistic growth.

cards.d: 数字を打ちこんで計算する、手のひらほどの機械。
s: 確かめたくなって、私は祖父の古い電卓を借りた。
電卓
Wanting to check for myself, I borrowed my grandfather's old calculator.
経理の彼女は、手元を見ずに電卓を打てる。
電卓
She works in accounting and can use a calculator without looking at her hands.
cf: 計算機 is broader (any calculating machine, and in academia 'computer'); 電卓 is the handheld calculator.
cards.note: Short for 電子式卓上計算機.

cards.g: to crunch the numbers; to work out whether something pays
cards.d: 損か得かを、細かく計算してみること。
s: 祖父は毎晩のように電卓を叩いて、繰り上げ返済ができる月を探したそうだ。
電卓を叩いて
Apparently he crunched the numbers nearly every night, looking for a month when he could make an early repayment.
引っ越すか今の家に住み続けるか、夫婦で電卓を叩いて決めた。
電卓を叩いて
We sat down as a couple, ran the numbers, and decided whether to move or stay put.
cf: そろばんをはじく has the same figurative sense, but often implies calculating one's own advantage.
cards.note: Can be literal (pressing calculator keys) or figurative (doing a cost-benefit calculation); the figurative use is common in business news.

cards.d: 計算をするための機械や道具。
s: 今ならスマートフォンの計算機アプリで一瞬だ。
計算機
Nowadays it takes a second with a calculator app on your smartphone.
大学の計算機センターで、夜遅くまでシミュレーションを走らせた。
計算機
I ran simulations late into the night at the university computing center.
cf: 電卓 is specifically the handheld electronic calculator; 計算機 is the general term.
Everyday word for computer; 計算機 survives for 'computer' in academic names (計算機科学 = computer science).

cards.g: synergy, mutual reinforcement (mainly in 相乗効果); multiplication
cards.d: 二つ以上のものが重なり合って、働きを強め合うこと。
s: 利率と時間が相乗的に効いてくるため、最初の数年はほとんど差がなくても、二十年、三十年と経つうちに両者の開きは歴然とする。
相乗
Because the rate and time reinforce each other, even if there's barely a difference in the first few years, after twenty or thirty years the gap between the two becomes unmistakable.
運動と食事の見直しを組み合わせると、相乗効果でやせやすくなる。
相乗
Combining exercise with changes to your diet has a synergistic effect that makes it easier to lose weight.
cf: あいのり = riding together or teaming up (タクシーに相乗り); same kanji, different word.
cards.note: Source gloss leads with 'multiplication', but that math sense is rare today (use 掛け算 / 乗法). In practice you meet 相乗効果 = synergy.

cards.g: fair compensation; what is given in return (for goods or work)
cards.d: 仕事や品物に見合うものとして、相手から受け取るお金など。
s: 「仕事には見合った対価を払う。だが損をさせられたら黙ってはいない」というのが祖父の流儀だった。
対価
'Pay a fair price for good work, but don't keep quiet if someone costs you money' — that was my grandfather's way.
ただ働きはおかしい、労働には正当な対価が必要だ。
対価
Unpaid work isn't right; labor deserves fair compensation.
cf: 代価 = the price paid, often figurative (勝利の代価 = the cost of victory); 対価 = what you get in exchange.
報酬 = remuneration specifically for work or services.
cards.note: 'Consideration' in the source gloss is the contract-law sense; 対価 is indeed the legal term for it.

cards.g: (wasteful) expense; waste of money or effort
cards.d: むだに出ていくお金や手間。
s: それでも祖父は手元の資金を取り崩さず、仕入れを絞り、無駄な費えを一つずつ削っていった。
費え
Even so, my grandfather didn't dip into the funds he had on hand; he cut back on stock and trimmed wasteful expenses one by one.
使いもしない会員権を持ち続けるのは、ただの費えでしかない。
費え
Holding on to a membership you never use is nothing but a waste of money.
cf: 費用 is the neutral everyday word for cost; 費え is literary and carries a sense of waste.
ついえる = to collapse, be dashed (夢が潰える); same sound, different word.
cards.note: Literary and somewhat old-fashioned; rare in speech. Related to the verb 費える (ついえる, to be wasted).

cards.g: lost earnings / lost profits (as legal damages)
cards.d: 事故や相手のミスがなければ得られたはずの、もうけや収入。
s: ところが業者の手違いで工期が一か月も延び、祖父はその間に得られたはずの売り上げを逸失利益として請求した。
逸失利益
But the contractor's mistake pushed the work back a whole month, and my grandfather claimed the sales he would have made in that time as lost profits.
交通事故の賠償では、被害者が将来得たはずの収入も逸失利益として計算される。
逸失利益
In traffic-accident damages, the income the victim would have earned in the future is also calculated as lost earnings.
cf: 機会費用 = opportunity cost, an economics concept; 逸失利益 is a legal claim for income lost through someone else's fault.
cards.note: A legal/insurance term; you meet it in court reports and accident-compensation news.

cards.g: splitting fifty-fifty; sharing equally between two
cards.d: お金などを、二人で半分ずつに分けること。
s: 改装工事では、隣の店と共用する看板の費用を折半した。
折半
During the renovation, he split the cost of the sign he shared with the shop next door fifty-fifty.
駅からのタクシー代は、二人で折半しようよ。
折半
Let's split the taxi fare from the station between the two of us.
cf: 割り勘 = splitting a bill equally among any number of people; 折半 is strictly halves, often between two parties or companies.

cards.d: 仕事や活動を続けていくためにかかるお金。
s: 古いノートには、毎月の売り上げや経費が几帳面な字で記されている。
経費
The old notebooks record each month's sales and expenses in meticulous handwriting.
この打ち合わせのコーヒー代って、経費で落ちるかな。
経費
Do you think the coffee for this meeting can go on expenses?
cf: 費用 = cost in general; 経費 = the operating expenses of a business or activity, especially ones you can claim.
cards.note: 経費で落ちる / 経費で落とす ('to expense it') is everyday office talk.

cards.g: stocktaking, inventory count; (fig.) taking stock of one's skills / listing faults
cards.d: 店や倉庫にある商品の数や値打ちを、すべて数えて調べること。
s: 年度末には決まって、「棚卸」と書かれたページがあった。
棚卸
At the end of every fiscal year, without fail, there was a page headed 'Stocktaking'.
年末の棚卸で、帳簿より在庫が二十個も少ないことがわかった。
棚卸
The year-end stocktake showed we had twenty fewer items in stock than the books said.
転職の前に、これまでの経験を棚卸ししてみよう。
棚卸し
Before changing jobs, let's take stock of the experience you've built up so far.
cards.note: Also written 棚卸し or 店卸し. Figuratively: taking stock of your own skills (common in job-hunting), or older usage, nitpicking someone's faults (人の棚卸し).

cards.g: inventory (accounting): goods and materials held for sale
cards.d: 売るために持っている商品や材料を、会計でまとめて呼ぶことば。
s: 売れ残った商品も棚卸資産として帳簿に載り、利益の計算に関わってくると知ったのは、会計の授業を受けてからである。
棚卸資産
It was only after taking an accounting class that I learned unsold goods also go on the books as inventory and affect how profit is calculated.
棚卸資産が膨らむのは、売れない在庫を抱えている合図かもしれない。
棚卸資産
Swelling inventories may be a sign that a company is sitting on stock it can't sell.
cf: 在庫 = stock on hand, the everyday business word; 棚卸資産 = the balance-sheet category.
cards.note: Appears in financial statements and earnings news.

cards.g: the economy, business conditions; (colloq.) liveliness, spirit
cards.d: 物の売り買いやお金の動きなど、世の中の経済の調子。
s: やがて景気はゆっくりと回復に向かった。
景気
Eventually the economy began slowly to recover.
ボーナスも出たし、今日は景気よくパーッと飲もう！
景気
We got our bonuses, so let's go all out and have a big night tonight!
cf: 経済 = the economy as a system; 景気 = its current state (good or bad times).
cards.note: 景気のいい = upbeat, lively (景気のいい話, 景気のいい掛け声); 景気づけ = something to lift the mood.

cards.d: 物が売れず、会社や人々のお金の回りが悪くなっている状態。
s: 町の工場が相次いで閉鎖され、地域全体が長い不況に沈んだ時期だ。
不況
That was when the town's factories closed one after another and the whole area sank into a long recession.
出版不況と言われて久しいが、この本屋はいつも客でにぎわっている。
不況
People have been talking about a publishing slump for years, yet this bookstore is always busy.
cf: 不景気 is the everyday word for hard times; 不況 is the news/economics term.
恐慌 = a panic or depression, far more severe (世界恐慌).
cards.note: Often prefixed by an industry: 出版不況, 造船不況, 建設不況.

cards.d: 悪くなったものが、もとのよい状態にもどること。
s: やがて景気はゆっくりと回復に向かった。
回復
Eventually the economy began slowly to recover.
熱は下がったけど、体力が回復するまでもう少し休みなさい。
回復
Your fever's gone, but rest a bit longer until you get your strength back.
cf: 快復 is a less common spelling used only for recovery from illness; 回復 covers every sense.
cards.note: Source gloss includes 'replevin', a legal term you will essentially never need for this word.

cards.d: かたよりや無理がなく、しっかりしていて問題のないようす。
s: 「借りすぎず、ためこみすぎず。健全な店とは、それだけのことだ。」
健全
'Don't borrow too much, don't hoard too much. That's all a sound business is.'
子どもたちには、安心して遊べる健全な環境が必要だ。
健全
Children need a wholesome environment where they can play safely.
cf: 健康 = physical health of a body; 健全 = soundness of systems, finances, organizations or minds.

title.ja: 覇権の盤面 — 冷戦と半導体摩擦
title.en: The hegemony board: the Cold War and chip trade friction

modules.passageTitle: 半導体をめぐる覇権の盤面 ― 日米摩擦から何を読むか

cards.g: the Cold War; cold war (tense standoff without open fighting)
cards.d: 武力で直接戦わずに、二つの陣営が長くにらみ合う対立。
s: 冷戦のさなか、アメリカはソ連と軍事技術を競い合っていた。
冷戦
In the midst of the Cold War, America was competing with the Soviet Union in military technology.
あの二人、口もきかないし、もう完全に冷戦状態だよ。
冷戦
Those two aren't even speaking — it's a total cold war between them now.
cf: れいせい (calm, composed) sounds close; 冷戦 is れいせん, a standoff/conflict.
cards.note: Capital-C Cold War (1947–1991) by default; casually also any frosty standoff between people, companies or countries (米中の新冷戦).

cards.g: hegemony; supremacy, domination (of a field or market)
cards.d: ほかを圧倒する力で、ある地域や分野を支配すること。
s: 日米半導体摩擦は、覇権をめぐる力学が同盟の内側でも働くことを示した事例といえる。
覇権
The US–Japan chip friction can be seen as a case showing that the dynamics of hegemony operate even within an alliance.
スマホ市場の覇権を握ったのは、後から参入した会社だった。
覇権
The company that seized dominance of the smartphone market was a latecomer.
cf: 派遣 (はけん) = dispatching staff/troops, as in 派遣社員. Same reading, unrelated meaning.
cards.note: Used for geopolitics and, very commonly, for business and sport (業界の覇権争い). 覇権を握る is the stock verb.

cards.d: 強大な一国が秩序を支えると国際経済が安定する、とする国際政治学の説。
s: この経緯を国際政治学の目で読み解くとき、しばしば参照されるのが覇権安定論である。
覇権安定論
When reading this history through the lens of international politics, hegemonic stability theory is often invoked.
ゼミでは、覇権安定論の弱点について一時間も議論した。
覇権安定論
In the seminar we spent a whole hour discussing the weaknesses of hegemonic stability theory.
col: 覇権安定論を批判する
cards.note: International-relations term (associated with Kindleberger and later Gilpin, Keohane's critiques). Also seen as 覇権安定理論.

cards.d: 輸出入の偏りなどをめぐって、国と国の間に生じる対立。
s: 半導体は一気に日米貿易摩擦の焦点となった。
貿易摩擦
Semiconductors suddenly became the focal point of US–Japan trade friction.
関税の引き上げで、両国の貿易摩擦が再燃している。
貿易摩擦
Tariff hikes have reignited trade friction between the two countries.
cf: 貿易戦争 is a full-blown tit-for-tat tariff war; 貿易摩擦 is the broader, milder 'friction'.
cards.note: Classic news term from the 1980s US–Japan era (cars, steel, chips); still standard today.

cards.d: そのままにしておけないほど重大で、心配な。
s: そうした中で、肝心の部品の供給を他国に握られることは由々しき事態と受け止められた。
由々しき
Against that backdrop, having the supply of such a vital component held by another country was seen as an alarming situation.
若い世代の読解力の低下は、由々しき問題だと校長は語った。
由々しき
The principal said the decline in young people's reading ability is a grave problem.
cf: 深刻な is the neutral everyday 'serious'; 由々しき is formal and carries a sense of alarm or reproach.
cards.note: Fossilized classical attributive form of ゆゆし; only used before a noun (由々しき事態). Stiff, speech-and-editorial register. Also written ゆゆしき.

cards.d: 国や団体どうしが話し合って取り決めた約束。
s: それでもアメリカは翌年、協定が守られていないとして日本製品の一部に報復関税を課している。
協定
Even so, the following year the US, claiming the agreement was not being honored, imposed retaliatory tariffs on some Japanese products.
労使協定で、残業は月三十時間までと決められている。
協定
Under the labor–management agreement, overtime is capped at thirty hours a month.
cf: 条約 is a formal treaty ratified by parliament; 協定 is a broader 'agreement', often administrative or sectoral.
契約 is a contract between private parties; 協定 is between states, unions, organizations.
cards.note: The 1986 日米半導体協定 (US–Japan Semiconductor Agreement) is the textbook example.

cards.d: 一つの家族などが多くの会社を支配する巨大な企業グループ。
s: その隙を突いたのが、韓国の財閥系企業である。
財閥
It was Korean chaebol-affiliated companies that seized that opening.
戦後、日本の財閥は占領軍の方針で解体された。
財閥
After the war, Japan's zaibatsu were dismantled under the occupation's policy.
cf: 系列 (keiretsu) is the looser postwar network of affiliated firms; 財閥 is the prewar family-controlled holding structure — or Korean chaebol.
cards.note: Korean 'chaebol' (재벌) is the same word, written with the same kanji, so 韓国の財閥 is the normal way to say 'chaebol' in Japanese.

cards.g: gaining full control (of an area/market); suppression, subduing
cards.d: 力で相手をおさえつけ、支配下に置くこと。
s: 大胆な先行投資を切り札に、彼らはDRAM市場を短期間で制圧した。
制圧
With bold up-front investment as their trump card, they took control of the DRAM market in a short time.
警察は立てこもっていた男を十分ほどで制圧した。
制圧
The police subdued the barricaded man in about ten minutes.
cf: 鎮圧 is quelling a riot/uprising; 制圧 is taking control of a place, opponent or market.
征服 is conquest (of a country, a peak); stronger and more permanent.
cards.note: Military/police word used figuratively in sports and business (中盤を制圧する in football or shogi).

cards.d: 話し合いがまとまらず、物別れに終わること。
s: 交渉は何度も決裂の危機に瀕したが、一九八六年、両国政府は日米半導体協定を結ぶ。
決裂
Talks repeatedly came close to collapse, but in 1986 the two governments concluded the US–Japan Semiconductor Agreement.
賃上げをめぐる労使交渉は、深夜になって決裂した。
決裂
The labor–management negotiations over pay raises broke down late at night.
cf: 分裂 is a group or party splitting apart; 決裂 is negotiations failing.
cards.note: Almost always with 交渉 / 会談 / 協議 as subject.

cards.g: center, core, nerve center (of an organization or system)
cards.d: 全体を動かすいちばん大切な中心の部分。
s: 冷戦期のアメリカにとって、軍事と直結する半導体は国家戦略の中枢にあった。
中枢
For Cold War America, semiconductors, tied directly to the military, sat at the core of national strategy.
呼吸を調節する中枢は、脳の奥にある。
中枢
The center that regulates breathing lies deep in the brain.
cf: 中核 is 'core' as the main component; 中枢 stresses the controlling, command function (and is the anatomy word).
cards.note: Also a medical/biology term: 中枢神経 = central nervous system.

cards.d: 国が方針として決めて進める政策。
s: 半導体を国策として育てたこの取り組みが、のちの躍進の礎を築いたとされる。
国策
This effort to nurture semiconductors as national policy is said to have laid the foundation for the later leap forward.
あの会社は、ほとんど国策会社のような扱いを受けている。
国策
That company is treated almost like a state-backed enterprise.
cf: 政策 is any policy; 国策 is a policy pursued as a top national priority, often with the state steering industry.
cards.note: Can carry a slightly critical tone (国策捜査 = politically motivated prosecution).

cards.g: to catch up on, close the gap with (a leader)
cards.d: 先を行く相手との差を少しずつ縮めて迫る。
s: 日本勢は先行するアメリカ企業を猛烈に追い上げ、八〇年代半ばにはDRAM市場で首位を奪う。
追い上げ
The Japanese makers fiercely closed in on the leading American firms and took the top spot in DRAM by the mid-1980s.
九回に三点を返して追い上げたが、あと一歩及ばなかった。
追い上げ
They clawed back three runs in the ninth but fell just short.
cf: 追い越す = to overtake; 追い上げる = to close the gap (not necessarily passing).
追い付く = to draw level; 追い上げる describes the chase itself.
cards.note: Noun form 追い上げ is very common in sports commentary (猛追とも).

cards.d: 相手より勢いや力が弱く、不利な立場にあること。
s: 劣勢に立たされたアメリカの業界は、日本製品が不当な安値で売られていると訴えた。
劣勢
Pushed onto the back foot, the American industry claimed Japanese products were being sold at unfairly low prices.
序盤は劣勢だったが、終盤の一手で形勢が逆転した。
劣勢
He was behind in the opening, but a single move in the endgame turned the position around.
cf: 劣性 (also れっせい) = recessive (genetics); 劣勢 = losing position. Note 劣性 is now often replaced by 潜性.
Antonym: 優勢 = advantage, leading position.
cards.note: Frequent in shogi/go coverage and election reporting (劣勢が伝えられる候補).

cards.g: to dominate, control, run the show
cards.d: 集団や組織の中心に立ち、思いどおりに動かす。
s: たとえ同盟国であっても、卓越した技術でその分野を牛耳ることまでは許されない。
牛耳る
Even an ally would not be allowed to go so far as to dominate the field with superior technology.
この町内会は、昔から一部の古株に牛耳られている。
牛耳られ
This neighborhood association has long been run by a few old-timers.
cf: 支配する is neutral 'control'; 牛耳る implies one party calling all the shots, often with disapproval.
cards.note: From 牛耳を執る (to hold the ox's ear — the leader of an ancient Chinese alliance). Often slightly negative.

cards.d: 勢いのあったものが、おとろえて落ちぶれること。
s: 九〇年代に入ると、日本の半導体産業は凋落の道をたどる。
凋落
Entering the 1990s, Japan's semiconductor industry went into decline.
かつての名門球団の凋落ぶりに、古いファンは嘆いている。
凋落
Longtime fans lament how far the once-proud club has fallen.
cf: 没落 is a more total fall (a family or class ruined); 凋落 is decline/withering of power or popularity.
衰退 is the neutral 'decline'; 凋落 is more literary and dramatic.
cards.note: Literally 'withering and falling' of leaves; literary but common in headlines.

cards.d: 生き残るか滅びるかを左右する、めぐり合わせ。
s: では、日本の半導体産業の命運はすでに尽きたのだろうか。
命運
So has the fate of Japan's semiconductor industry already run out?
この新製品に会社の命運がかかっている。
命運
The company's fate hinges on this new product.
cf: 運命 is general 'destiny' (also romantic); 命運 specifically means survival-or-ruin stakes, typical in news.
cards.note: Same kanji as 運命 reversed; 命運 is the one for 'make-or-break' contexts.

cards.g: trump card; ace up one's sleeve, decisive move
cards.d: いざという時に使う、いちばん効き目のある手段。
s: 大胆な先行投資を切り札に、彼らはDRAM市場を短期間で制圧した。
切り札
With bold up-front investment as their trump card, they took control of the DRAM market in a short time.
延長戦で、監督はついに切り札の代打を送った。
切り札
In extra innings, the manager finally sent in his ace pinch hitter.
cf: 奥の手 is a hidden secret technique; 切り札 is the strongest card, which may be known to all.
cards.note: From card games (trump). Widely used for policies, players, products.

cards.d: 物事が大きく動き出すきっかけになるもの。
s: 政府の支援を産業再生の起爆剤にできるかどうかは、過去の摩擦から何を学んだかにかかっている。
起爆剤
Whether government support can become the catalyst for an industrial revival depends on what was learned from past friction.
新しい駅の開業が、商店街を活性化する起爆剤になった。
起爆剤
The opening of the new station became the spark that revived the shopping street.
col: 起爆剤として期待される
cf: きっかけ is any trigger; 起爆剤 implies something that sets off a big burst of activity.
呼び水 = priming water; something that draws further investment/action. Close in news usage.
cards.note: Source gloss 'triggering explosive' is only the literal sense; in news it is almost always figurative 'catalyst for growth'.

cards.d: 物事がうまくいかないと考えて、望みを失うこと。
s: 悲観する声は根強いが、製造装置や素材では今も日本企業が高いシェアを保っている。
悲観
Pessimistic voices persist, but in manufacturing equipment and materials Japanese firms still hold large market shares.
一度の失敗で、そんなに悲観することはないよ。
悲観
No need to be so down about a single failure.
cf: 悲哀 is sorrow/pathos; 悲観 is a pessimistic outlook.
cards.note: 悲観的 (pessimistic) is the most frequent derivative.

cards.d: 驚くほど勢いや程度が激しい。
s: その勢いは凄まじく、八〇年代後半には世界の半導体市場のおよそ半分を日本企業が占めた。
凄まじく
Their momentum was tremendous; by the late 1980s Japanese firms held about half the world semiconductor market.
台風が通過した夜は、凄まじい風の音で眠れなかった。
凄まじい
The night the typhoon passed, I couldn't sleep for the ferocious roar of the wind.
cf: 凄い (すごい) is the everyday 'amazing/very'; 凄まじい is stronger and more vivid, often of force or noise.
cards.note: Can be positive or negative depending on context. Often written すさまじい in kana.

cards.d: ほかよりはるかにすぐれていること。
s: たとえ同盟国であっても、卓越した技術でその分野を牛耳ることまでは許されない。
卓越
Even an ally would not be allowed to go so far as to dominate the field with superior technology.
彼女は卓越した語学力を生かして、国際機関で働いている。
卓越
She puts her outstanding language skills to use working at an international organization.
cf: 優秀 = excellent (grades, staff); 卓越 = towering above others, more formal.
卓抜 (たくばつ) is a rarer synonym, mostly of ideas: 卓抜な発想.
cards.note: Mostly in the form 卓越した + noun.

cards.d: 全体を支え、それがないと成り立たない重要なもの。
s: その生産能力は、経済だけでなく安全保障の要石でもあった。
要石
That production capacity was a keystone not only of the economy but of national security.
鹿島神宮の要石は、地震を起こすナマズを押さえていると伝えられる。
要石
The keystone at Kashima Shrine is said to hold down the catfish that causes earthquakes.
cf: 礎 is a foundation stone at the base; 要石 is the stone that holds everything together at the critical point.
かなめ (要) is the general word for 'pivot, crucial point'; 要石 is its stone/keystone image.
cards.note: Literal: the keystone of an arch, or the sacred stones at Kashima/Katori shrines. Figuratively 'linchpin' (沖縄は太平洋の要石).

cards.g: pivot, crucial point, linchpin (要); fan rivet; Japanese photinia
cards.d: 物事のいちばん大事なところ。扇の骨を留める部分から。
s: 裏を返せば、覇権国は秩序のかなめとなる分野で挑戦者が台頭すると、ルールそのものを書き換えることもいとわない。
かなめ
Conversely, when a challenger rises in a field that is the linchpin of the order, the hegemon will not hesitate to rewrite the rules themselves.
守備のかなめであるキャッチャーがけがで離脱した。
かなめ
The catcher, the linchpin of the defense, is out with an injury.
cf: 要石 is the keystone/linchpin image; かなめ is the general 'crucial point'.
Same kanji read よう in compounds (重要, 要点); かなめ is the native standalone reading.
cards.note: Usually written 要. Originally the rivet at the base of a folding fan. The plant sense (カナメモチ, Japanese photinia) is a separate, rarer usage.

cards.d: 建物の土台の石。また、物事を支えるもとになるもの。
s: この強みこそが再起の礎になるという見方もある。
礎
Some see this very strength as the foundation for a comeback.
創業者たちの苦労が、今日の繁栄の礎となった。
礎
The founders' hardships became the cornerstone of today's prosperity.
cf: 基礎 (きそ) is the everyday 'basics/foundation'; 礎 is literary and solemn.
要石 holds a structure together at its key point; 礎 is the base it stands on.
cards.note: Learn as the word いしずえ (from 石据え, 'set stone'). On reading ソ appears in 礎石 (そせき) and 基礎.

cards.d: のちの発展を支える土台をつくる。
s: 半導体を国策として育てたこの取り組みが、のちの躍進の礎を築いたとされる。
礎を築いた
This effort to nurture semiconductors as national policy is said to have laid the foundation for the later leap forward.
彼は小さな工房から始め、今の会社の礎を築いた。
礎を築いた
Starting from a small workshop, he laid the foundation of today's company.
cf: 基礎を固める = to consolidate the basics; 礎を築く = to build the base from which something great later grows.
cards.note: Typical of obituaries, company histories and speeches.

cards.d: 数や量が非常に多いようす。
s: 設計から製造までを一社で抱える日本型のモデルは、膨大な投資負担に耐えきれなくなっていく。
膨大
The Japanese model of keeping everything from design to fabrication in one company could no longer bear the enormous investment burden.
引っ越しの前に、膨大な量の古い書類を処分した。
膨大
Before moving, I got rid of a huge pile of old documents.
cf: 莫大 (ばくだい) is typically money/damage (莫大な損害); 膨大 is volume/quantity (膨大な資料). Overlap is large.
膨張 = expansion, swelling (a process); 膨大 = enormous (a state).
cards.note: The 'swelling' sense in the source gloss is rare; read it as 'enormous'.

cards.d: 規模や大きさを小さくすること。
s: バブル崩壊後の不況で、各社は設備投資を縮小せざるをえなかった。
縮小
In the recession after the bubble burst, every company had no choice but to cut back capital investment.
この写真、半分くらいに縮小してから送ってくれる？
縮小
Could you shrink this photo to about half size before sending it?
cf: 削減 = cutting an amount (costs, staff); 縮小 = shrinking the scale/size.
cards.note: Used both for business scale and for literally shrinking images/copies.

cards.d: 同じ製品を一度にたくさん作ること。
s: 各社はメモリーの一種であるDRAMに資源を集中し、高い品質で量産する技術を磨いた。
量産
Each company concentrated resources on DRAM, a type of memory, and honed the skills to mass-produce it at high quality.
あの監督、最近は似たような映画を量産してるよね。
量産
That director has been churning out pretty similar films lately, hasn't he?
cf: 大量生産 is the full form; 量産 is the short form used in industry and news.
cards.note: Casually also 'churning out' anything in quantity (often a little mocking).

cards.d: 仕事をいくつかに分け、それぞれ別の人が受け持つこと。
s: さらに、設計専業の企業と製造を請け負う企業との分業が世界に広がった。
分業
On top of that, a division of labor between design-only firms and contract manufacturers spread worldwide.
うちは料理は夫、片付けは私と、家事を分業している。
分業
At our place we split the housework: my husband cooks and I clean up.
cf: 分担 = sharing out tasks or costs; 分業 = a system where each party specializes in one stage.
cards.note: In the chip industry: the fabless (設計) / foundry (製造) split.

title.ja: 砂から回路へ — 半導体ができるまで
title.en: From sand to circuits: how a chip is made

modules.passageTitle: 砂から回路へ — 半導体ができるまで

cards.g: accumulation; concentration (in one place); integration (of circuits)
cards.d: 多くのものを一か所に集めて積み重ねること。また、集まっていること。
s: 部品を高い密度で集積するほど、信号の通り道は短くなり、性能は上がる。
集積
The more densely components are integrated, the shorter the signal paths and the higher the performance.
駅の周辺には、飲食店や商業施設が集積している。
集積
Restaurants and commercial facilities are concentrated around the station.
cf: 蓄積 is building up a stock over time (knowledge, fatigue, savings); 集積 is gathering things together in one place.
cards.note: Common in economics (産業集積 'industrial cluster') and electronics. Written/technical; in speech you'd say 集まっている.

cards.d: たくさんの電子部品と配線を、一枚の小さな板の上にまとめて作った回路。
s: さらに1958年から59年にかけて、多数の素子と配線を一枚の基板の上にまとめて作る集積回路が考案された。
集積回路
Then, between 1958 and 1959, the integrated circuit, which builds many elements and their wiring together on a single substrate, was devised.
このゲーム機には、専用に設計された集積回路が使われている。
集積回路
This game console uses a custom-designed integrated circuit.
cf: In everyday and industry talk people usually just say IC, チップ or 半導体; LSI (大規模集積回路) is the large-scale kind.
cards.note: Formal/technical term. News tends to say 半導体 loosely for chips in general.

cards.d: 空気を抜いたガラスの管の中で電子の流れを操り、信号を強める部品。
s: 1946年に公開されたENIACは約一万八千本もの真空管を使い、故障が絶えなかったという。
真空管
ENIAC, unveiled in 1946, used some 18,000 vacuum tubes and was said to break down constantly.
父は今でも真空管のアンプで古いレコードを聴いている。
真空管
My father still listens to old records on a tube amp.
cards.note: Today mostly heard among audio enthusiasts (真空管アンプ) and in the history of computing. Counter: 本.

cards.d: 機械や道具が、どれだけうまく働くかという力の程度。
s: 部品を高い密度で集積するほど、信号の通り道は短くなり、性能は上がる。
性能
The more densely components are integrated, the shorter the signal paths and the higher the performance.
このカメラは値段のわりに性能がいいね。
性能
This camera performs really well for the price.
cf: 機能 = what a thing can do (its functions/features); 性能 = how well it does it (performance).
cards.note: Used of machines, cars, devices, materials — not of people's ability (use 能力 for people).

cards.d: 製品を作るときの、材料から完成までの作業の順番と段階。
s: 新しい製造工程を立ち上げた直後は歩留まりが低く、技術者たちは不良の原因を一つずつつぶしていく。
製造工程
Right after a new manufacturing process is brought up, yields are low, and engineers eliminate the causes of defects one by one.
このパンの製造工程は、工場見学で誰でも見ることができる。
製造工程
Anyone can see how this bread is made on a factory tour.
col: 製造工程で異物が混入する
cf: 製法 is the method/recipe itself (often a secret or tradition); 製造工程 is the sequence of production steps on the line.
cards.note: Very common in news about product recalls: 製造工程で異物が混入した 'a foreign object got in during production'.

cards.g: yield (ratio of good output to input)
cards.d: 使った材料や作った数のうち、良い製品として使える分の割合。
s: 良品の割合を示す歩留まりは、工場の利益を左右する最も重要な数字の一つだ。
歩留まり
Yield, the share of good units, is one of the most important numbers determining a fab's profit.
この魚は骨が多くて、食べられる身の歩留まりが悪い。
歩留まり
This fish is so bony that the yield of edible meat is poor.
cf: 稼働率 is how much of the time equipment is running; 歩留まり is how much of the output is usable.
cards.note: Also written 歩留り. Used in manufacturing, cooking (usable portion of an ingredient), and admissions (share of accepted students who enroll).

cards.d: 物を作るやり方。材料や手順、条件などをまとめたもの。
s: 何度の温度でどの気体を何秒流すかといった製法の細部は「レシピ」と呼ばれ、各社が厳重に守る企業秘密になっている。
製法
Fine details of the method, such as which gas to flow at what temperature for how many seconds, are called 'recipes' and are closely guarded trade secrets.
この店のしょうゆは、江戸時代から変わらない製法で造られている。
製法
This shop's soy sauce is brewed by a method unchanged since the Edo period.
cf: 工法 is a construction/engineering method (buildings, tunnels); 製法 is how a product or food is made.
製造工程 = the production steps; 製法 = the method or recipe behind them.
cards.note: Loves food and craft marketing: 昔ながらの製法 'old-fashioned method'.

cards.d: 程度がとても高いこと。また、海面や地面から測った高さ。
s: どれほど高度な技術を使っても、一枚のウエハーから取れるチップがすべて正しく動くわけではない。
高度
No matter how advanced the technology, not every chip from a wafer will work properly.
当機は現在、高度一万メートルを飛行しております。
高度
We are currently flying at an altitude of 10,000 meters.
cf: Homophone こうど: 硬度 = hardness (of minerals, water).
高等 = higher (level/grade), as in 高等学校; 高度 = advanced/sophisticated or altitude.
cards.note: As na-adj (高度な) it means 'advanced, sophisticated'; as a noun with numbers it's 'altitude'.

cards.g: mounting (components on a board); implementation (of a feature)
cards.d: 部品を基板に取り付けること。また、考えた機能を実際に作り込むこと。
s: 完成したチップは一つずつ切り分けられ、パッケージに収められてから電子機器の基板に実装される。
実装
Finished chips are cut apart one by one, packaged, and then mounted on the boards of electronic devices.
要望の多かったダークモードを、次のアップデートで実装します。
実装
We'll implement the much-requested dark mode in the next update.
cf: 搭載 = a product 'comes with/is equipped with' a feature (marketing view); 実装 = actually building/mounting it (engineer's view).
cards.note: Hardware sense: mounting/packaging. Software sense: implementation. 社会実装 is policy jargon for putting research into real-world use.

cards.d: 前からすでにあること。
s: 既存の設備をどこまで生かせるかが、投資の成否を分けることも多い。
既存
How far existing equipment can be put to use often decides whether an investment succeeds.
新しい規約は、既存の会員にも適用されます。
既存
The new terms also apply to existing members.
cf: 既成 = already established/accomplished (既成概念, 既成事実).
cards.note: Traditional reading きそん; きぞん is now very common too and accepted in many dictionaries.

cards.d: 新しく入れるものではなく、前から使っている機械や設備。
s: そこで、既存装置に改良を加えて、より細かい回路を描けるようにする工夫も欠かせない。
既存装置
So it is also essential to improve existing equipment so it can draw finer circuits.
新しい制御ソフトは、既存装置にもそのまま導入できる。
既存装置
The new control software can be installed on existing equipment as is.
cards.note: A compound typical of technical documents and spec sheets; in ordinary prose 既存の装置 or 既存設備 is more common.

cards.d: 電気が流れるように線を張りめぐらせてつなぐこと。その線。
s: トランジスタ同士をつなぐ配線にも工夫が詰まっている。
配線
The wiring that connects the transistors is also full of ingenuity.
テレビの裏の配線がごちゃごちゃで、どれがどれだか分からない。
配線
The cables behind the TV are such a tangle I can't tell which is which.
cf: 配電 = distributing electric power (utility grid); 配線 = the wiring/cabling itself.
cards.note: Everyday for the cable mess behind your desk, and technical for chip interconnects.

cards.d: 電気や熱をよく通す物質。金属など。
s: 電気をよく通す導体と、電気を通さない絶縁体を交互に重ね、十層を超える配線網を作るのだ。
導体
Layers of conductor, which carries electricity well, and insulator, which doesn't, are stacked alternately to build a wiring network of more than ten levels.
金属は電気の良導体で、なかでも銀と銅はよく電気を通す。
導体
Metals are good conductors of electricity; silver and copper conduct especially well.
cf: Homophone どうたい: 胴体 = torso; fuselage.
半導体 = semiconductor, between a conductor and an insulator.
cards.note: Physics/school-science word. 不導体 is a synonym of 絶縁体.

cards.d: 銅で作った細い線。電気を通すのによく使われる。
s: 家庭の電気コードの中の銅線と同じ金属が、髪の毛の千分の一ほどの細い溝に埋め込まれているのである。
銅線
The same metal as the copper wire inside household power cords is buried in trenches about a thousandth the width of a hair.
工事現場から銅線が盗まれる事件が相次いでいる。
銅線
There has been a string of copper wire thefts from construction sites.
cf: Homophone どうせん: 導線 = (lead) wire as a conductor in general, whatever the metal; 銅線 = wire made of copper.
cards.note: Inside chips the term is 銅配線 (copper interconnect); 銅線 means actual copper wire.

cards.d: 電気や熱をほとんど通さない物質。ゴムやガラスなど。
s: 電気をよく通す導体と、電気を通さない絶縁体を交互に重ね、十層を超える配線網を作るのだ。
絶縁体
Layers of conductor, which carries electricity well, and insulator, which doesn't, are stacked alternately to build a wiring network of more than ten levels.
ゴムやガラスは、電気を通しにくい絶縁体だ。
絶縁体
Rubber and glass are insulators that hardly conduct electricity.
cf: 断熱材 = thermal insulation material (in walls); 絶縁体 is primarily electrical.
絶縁 alone also means cutting off relations (親子の絶縁).
cards.note: Synonym 不導体. Opposite: 導体.

cards.d: 絵や文字を描いて印刷に使う、平らな石の板。またそれで刷ったもの。
s: もとはギリシャ語で「石に書く」という意味で、石版に絵を描いて刷る印刷技法を指す言葉だった。
石版
Originally a Greek word meaning 'writing on stone,' it referred to a printing technique in which pictures are drawn on a litho stone and printed.
美術館で、十九世紀に石版で刷られたポスターを見た。
石版
At the museum I saw posters lithographed in the 19th century.
cf: In chipmaking, 'lithography' is always リソグラフィ (or 露光); 石版 is only the printing stone/art print.
Homophone せきばん: 石板 = a stone slab or a school slate.
cards.note: Source gloss 'lithography' is misleading: 石版 is the stone/print, the printing technique is 石版印刷, and semiconductor lithography is リソグラフィ.

cards.d: 光を当てたフィルムなどを薬で処理して、像を見えるようにすること。
s: 続いて、写真のフィルムと同じように現像すると、光の当たった部分だけが溶けて模様が浮かび上がる。
現像
Then, when it is developed just like photographic film, only the exposed areas dissolve and the pattern emerges.
旅行で撮ったフィルムを、写真屋さんに現像してもらった。
現像
I had the film from my trip developed at the photo shop.
cf: 現象 (げんしょう) = phenomenon; looks similar, different reading and meaning.
cards.note: Digital photographers use RAW現像 for processing RAW files.

cards.d: 表面を少しずつそぎ取ること。また、そぎ取ったくず。
s: 露光と現像、そして削りの作業を何十回も繰り返し、回路は一層ずつ積み上がっていく。
削り
By repeating exposure, development and etching dozens of times, the circuit is built up layer by layer.
鉛筆削りが壊れたので、カッターで鉛筆を削った。
削り
My pencil sharpener broke, so I sharpened the pencil with a box cutter.
cf: 削減 (さくげん) = cutting costs/numbers; same kanji, abstract sense.
cards.note: Mostly lives in compounds (鉛筆削り, かつお削り節, 削り出し 'machined from solid'). In chipmaking the actual term for this step is エッチング.

cards.d: 沸く温度の違いを使って、液体の混ざり物をいくつかに分けること。
s: そこで、シリコンをいったん液体の化合物に変え、分留を繰り返してわずかな不純物まで取り除く。
分留
So the silicon is first converted into a liquid compound, and repeated fractional distillation removes even trace impurities.
原油は分留によって、ガソリンや灯油、重油などに分けられる。
分留
Crude oil is separated by fractional distillation into gasoline, kerosene, heavy oil and so on.
cf: 蒸留 = distillation in general; 分留 = separating a mixture into several fractions by boiling point.
cards.note: Also written 分溜 (older form). Classic high-school chemistry term (原油の分留).

cards.d: 液体などをかき回して、むらなく混ぜ合わせること。
s: 融液をゆっくり攪拌しながら種結晶を引き上げると、円柱形の大きな単結晶ができる。
攪拌
When a seed crystal is pulled up while the melt is slowly stirred, a large cylindrical single crystal forms.
ミキサーで材料を攪拌し、なめらかなペースト状にする。
攪拌
Blend the ingredients in a mixer into a smooth paste.
cards.note: Often written 撹拌 or かくはん because 攪 is not a jōyō kanji. かくはん is a customary reading; the original reading was こうはん. Everyday speech says かき混ぜる.

cards.g: natural science (esp. as an academic field)
cards.d: 物理や化学、生物など、自然のしくみを研究する学問。
s: 半導体の製造は、量子力学をはじめとする理学の成果と、精密な工学の技術とが出会う場所だと言える。
理学
Chipmaking can be called the place where the fruits of natural science, starting with quantum mechanics, meet precise engineering.
姉は大学の理学部で化学を勉強している。
理学
My sister studies chemistry in the university's faculty of science.
cf: 工学 = engineering (applied); 理学 = pure natural science.
理科 = 'science' as a school subject.
cards.note: Met mostly in 理学部 (faculty of science) and 理学療法 (physical therapy). The 'physics' and Song Neo-Confucian senses in the source gloss are historical.

cards.d: 物事が始まるところ。道や線が始まる場所。
s: その起点をたどると、二十世紀前半に広く使われた真空管に行き着く。
起点
Trace it back to its starting point and you arrive at the vacuum tube, widely used in the early twentieth century.
このマラソンコースは、市役所前を起点にしている。
起点
This marathon course starts in front of city hall.
cf: Homophone きてん: 基点 = reference point for measuring (～を基点に半径5km).
Homophone きてん: 機転 = quick wit (機転が利く).
cards.note: Opposite: 終点. Used for roads/rail lines and figuratively for the origin of a trend.

title.ja: 事件の夜 — 捜索・証言・立件
title.en: The night of the incident: search, testimony, prosecution

modules.passageTitle: 戻らなかったボート ― 三浦沖の捜索と、消えた証人

cards.g: defendant (in a criminal trial); the accused
cards.d: 刑事裁判で、罪を問われて訴えられている人。
s: 三人のうち一人は起訴され、被告人の男は法廷で起訴内容を否認している。
被告人
One of the three has been indicted, and the defendant has denied the charges in court.
裁判長は被告人に、最後に言っておきたいことはないかと尋ねた。
被告人
The presiding judge asked the defendant whether he had anything to say at the end.
cf: Legally 被告 is the defendant in a civil suit and 被告人 in a criminal trial, though the media call criminal defendants ～被告.
被疑者/容疑者 is a suspect before indictment; after 起訴 they become 被告人.
cards.note: News style: 「山田太郎被告（45）」 uses 被告 as a title even for criminal cases.

cards.d: 客のふりをして、店の品物をこっそり盗むこと。
s: 犯人たちは客を装い、閉店間際の売り場で堂々と万引きを重ねていた。
万引き
Posing as customers, the culprits brazenly shoplifted again and again on the sales floor just before closing time.
中学生のころ、友達が万引きをして店員に捕まった。
万引き
When I was in junior high, a friend was caught shoplifting by a store clerk.
cf: 窃盗 is the legal term for theft; 万引き is the everyday word for theft from a shop, legally 窃盗罪.
cards.note: Shops post 「万引きは犯罪です」 to counter the idea that it's a minor prank. Also means the person (=万引き犯).

cards.d: 借りた物や預かった物を、持ち主に返すこと。
s: 午後五時の返却期限を過ぎても戻らず、翌朝、沖合約二キロの海上で、転覆したボートが見つかった。
返却
It did not come back by the 5 p.m. return deadline, and the next morning the capsized boat was found at sea about two kilometres offshore.
図書館の本は来週の火曜日までに返却してください。
返却
Please return the library books by next Tuesday.
押収された商品の一部は、すでに店に返却されている。
返却
Some of the seized goods have already been returned to the store.
cf: 返済 is repaying money (ローンを返済する); 返却 is giving back an object.
返品 is returning purchased goods to a shop; 返却 is for borrowed or rented things.
返還 is formal/official return: territory, deposits, trophies (優勝旗の返還).
cards.note: Source gloss 'repayment' is misleading: money is 返済. 返却 is for objects — books, rentals, lost property, seized goods.

cards.g: building a case (for prosecution); charging a suspect
cards.d: 証拠を集めて、裁判にかけられる刑事事件として形にすること。
s: 警視庁は、男三人が共謀し、台車を使って商品を運び出していたとみて、窃盗の疑いで立件した。
立件
The Tokyo police built a theft case, believing the three men had conspired to wheel the goods out on a hand cart.
証拠が足りず、警察は詐欺での立件を見送った。
立件
For lack of evidence, the police decided not to bring a fraud case.
cf: 起訴 is the prosecutor formally indicting someone in court; 立件 is the earlier step of establishing a case (often by police).
逮捕 is arrest; a case can be 立件 without arrest (在宅のまま立件).

cards.d: 記事や文章の中身がひと目でわかるように付ける短い言葉。
s: 翌朝の新聞には「会社員、三浦沖で行方不明」の見出しが並んだ。
見出し
The next morning, the papers carried headlines reading 'Office worker missing off Miura'.
レポートは見出しをつけて、読みやすくまとめてください。
見出し
Please organise your report with headings so it's easy to read.
この辞書では、見出しの語が五十音順に並んでいる。
見出し
In this dictionary the headwords are arranged in kana order.
cf: 見出す (みいだす) is a verb, 'to find, discover' (希望を見出す) — same kanji, different word and reading.
cards.note: 見出しが躍る = headlines scream (sensational coverage).

cards.d: いつもの例とちがっていて、めったにないこと。
s: 裁判を目前に控えた証人が姿を消すのは異例の事態だ。
異例
It is highly unusual for a witness to disappear just before a trial.
社長が自ら謝罪会見に出るのは、この会社では異例のことだ。
異例
For this company, the president appearing in person at an apology press conference is unprecedented.
cf: 異常 means abnormal, something wrong; 異例 just means departing from usual practice.
cards.note: Typical in news about procedures and decisions: 異例の人事, 異例の長期政権.

cards.g: obliterating; wiping out (a person's existence or standing); erasing
cards.d: 存在そのものを、すっかり消し去ること。
s: 思い込みや不確かな証言によって、無実の人の人生が抹殺されることがあってはならない。
抹殺
An innocent person's life must never be wiped out because of preconceptions or unreliable testimony.
あの不祥事で、彼は業界から社会的に抹殺された。
抹殺
That scandal effectively erased him from the industry.
cf: 抹消 is deleting an entry or record (登録を抹消する); 抹殺 is erasing a person or their existence — far stronger.
黙殺 is ignoring something in silence (意見を黙殺する); 抹殺 is active obliteration.
cards.note: Strong word; in thrillers it can mean assassinating someone. The 'ignore an opinion' gloss is rare today — use 黙殺 for that.

cards.d: きのうの夜。また、日が暮れるころの時間。
s: 「夕べは急に風が出てきたから、心配していたんです」
夕べ
"The wind suddenly picked up last night, so I was worried."
市民ホールで「秋の音楽の夕べ」が開かれた。
夕べ
An 'Autumn Evening of Music' was held at the civic hall.
cf: 昨夜 (さくや) is the formal/news word for last night; it can also be read ゆうべ.
夕方 is late afternoon/dusk as a time of day; 夕べ in speech almost always means 'last night'.
cards.note: In conversation ゆうべ = last night (often written in kana). The 'evening' sense survives in event names like ～の夕べ.

cards.g: escape; getting out (of danger, confinement, a bad situation)
cards.d: 危ない場所や閉じこめられた所から、ぬけ出すこと。
s: 転覆の際に自力で脱出し、どこかの岸にたどり着いた可能性もある。
脱出
It is also possible that he got out by himself when the boat capsized and reached a shore somewhere.
日本経済は、ようやくデフレからの脱出が見えてきた。
脱出
The Japanese economy can finally see a way out of deflation.
cf: 脱走 is escaping from custody: prison, the army, a cage; 脱出 is getting out of danger or confinement in general.
逃亡 is fleeing to evade capture or responsibility; 脱出 has no sense of guilt.
cards.note: Source medical senses (prolapse, proptosis) are rare specialist uses; ignore them for reading news.

cards.g: search (for a missing person or thing); legal search of premises
cards.d: いなくなった人や物を探すこと。法に基づいて家などを調べること。
s: 第三管区海上保安本部は巡視艇とヘリコプターを出し、地元の漁船も加わって捜索を始めた。
捜索
The 3rd Regional Coast Guard Headquarters sent out patrol boats and a helicopter, and with local fishing boats joining in, began the search.
警察は社長の自宅を家宅捜索し、帳簿を押収した。
捜索
Police searched the company president's home and seized the account books.
cf: 捜査 is investigating a crime (who did it); 捜索 is physically searching for someone/something, or searching premises.
探索 is exploring or probing (宇宙探索); 捜索 is looking for something lost or missing.
cards.note: Two news senses: search-and-rescue (行方不明者の捜索) and the legal search (家宅捜索 = search of a home under warrant).

cards.g: Kanagawa Prefecture (south of Tokyo; capital Yokohama)
cards.d: 東京都の南どなりにある県。県庁は横浜市にある。
s: 神奈川県三浦市の小さなマリーナで、一隻の貸しボートが戻らなかったのは、九月最後の日曜日のことだった。
神奈川県
It was on the last Sunday of September that a rental boat failed to come back to a small marina in Miura, Kanagawa Prefecture.
週末は家族で神奈川県の箱根へ温泉旅行に行った。
神奈川県
At the weekend I went on a hot-spring trip to Hakone in Kanagawa with my family.
cards.note: In news, the prefectural police is 神奈川県警 (けんけい). Tokyo's police, by contrast, is 警視庁.

cards.d: どこへ行ったのか、今どこにいるのかわからないこと。
s: 翌朝の新聞には「会社員、三浦沖で行方不明」の見出しが並んだ。
行方不明
The next morning, the papers carried headlines reading 'Office worker missing off Miura'.
引っ越しのとき、大事な書類が行方不明になってしまった。
行方不明
Some important documents went missing when I moved house.
cf: 失踪 means vanishing, often by one's own choice; 行方不明 just states the whereabouts are unknown.
cards.note: 行方 is read ゆくえ. The police form is now 行方不明者届 (formerly 捜索願). Jokingly used of lost objects too.

cards.d: 海の上。海の水面やそのあたり。
s: 午後五時の返却期限を過ぎても戻らず、翌朝、沖合約二キロの海上で、転覆したボートが見つかった。
海上
It did not come back by the 5 p.m. return deadline, and the next morning the capsized boat was found at sea about two kilometres offshore.
台風の影響で、海上では大しけとなる見込みです。
海上
Because of the typhoon, seas are expected to be very rough.
cf: 海面 is the sea surface or sea level (海面上昇); 海上 is the area on the sea where things happen (海上で発見).
洋上 means out on the open ocean (洋上風力発電); 海上 is the everyday general word.
cards.note: 海上保安庁 is the Japan Coast Guard; 海上自衛隊 the Maritime Self-Defense Force.

cards.d: 天気予報や地震、津波などの情報を出す国の役所。
s: この日、気象庁は神奈川県の沿岸に波浪注意報を出していた。
気象庁
That day, the Japan Meteorological Agency had issued a high-wave advisory for the Kanagawa coast.
気象庁は、関東甲信地方が梅雨明けしたとみられると発表した。
気象庁
The Meteorological Agency announced that the rainy season appears to have ended in the Kanto-Koshin region.
cf: 気象台 are JMA's regional observatories (横浜地方気象台); 気象庁 is the national agency.
cards.note: Advisory = 注意報, warning = 警報, emergency warning = 特別警報.

cards.g: going to work; reporting for work
cards.d: 仕事をするために、勤め先へ行くこと。
s: 月曜日、森川さんは勤務先の家具店に出勤しなかった。
出勤
On Monday, Mr. Morikawa did not show up for work at the furniture store where he was employed.
明日は台風が来るので、出勤せずに家で仕事をします。
出勤
A typhoon is coming tomorrow, so I'll work from home instead of going in.
cf: 出社 is going to the company office specifically; 出勤 covers any workplace (store, hospital, site).
通勤 is the commute itself (通勤電車); 出勤 is the act of reporting for work.
cards.note: Opposite: 退勤 (clocking off). 無断欠勤 = absence without notice.

cards.g: storage furniture (shelves, cabinets, chests of drawers)
cards.d: 物をしまっておくための、棚やたんすなどの家具。
s: 昨年、都内の大型家具店で、組み立て式の収納家具などが繰り返し盗まれた事件だ。
収納家具
That was the case last year in which flat-pack storage furniture and other goods were repeatedly stolen from a large furniture store in Tokyo.
部屋が狭いので、壁に沿って背の高い収納家具を置いた。
収納家具
The room is small, so I put a tall storage unit along the wall.
col: 組み立て式の収納家具
cf: 収納 alone is storage space or putting things away (収納が多い部屋); 収納家具 is the furniture itself.
cards.note: Source gloss 'closet, cabinet' is too narrow: it is a category word used in shops and catalogues for any storage furniture. A built-in closet is クローゼット/押し入れ.

cards.d: 専門家が物を調べて、本物かどうかや価値などを判断すること。
s: 警視庁は専門家に画像の鑑定を依頼したが、解像度が低く、人物を特定する決定的な材料にはなっていない。
鑑定
The police asked experts to analyse the images, but the resolution is low and they have not provided anything conclusive to identify the person.
祖父の古い掛け軸を鑑定してもらったら、偽物だった。
鑑定
When we had my grandfather's old hanging scroll appraised, it turned out to be a fake.
cf: 鑑識 is police forensics / crime-scene work (鑑識課); 鑑定 is an expert's formal analysis or opinion.
査定 is assessing a price or performance (中古車の査定, 人事査定).

cards.d: 事件や事故を実際に見た人が、その様子を話すこと。
s: 売り場で一部始終を見ていた森川さんの目撃証言は、来月の公判で大きな意味を持つとみられていた。
目撃証言
Mr. Morikawa, who had seen the whole thing on the sales floor, was expected to give eyewitness testimony of great weight at next month's trial.
事故の目撃証言を集めるため、警察が現場付近でチラシを配った。
目撃証言
To gather eyewitness accounts of the accident, police handed out flyers near the scene.
col: 目撃証言が寄せられる
cf: 目撃情報 are sightings/tips from the public; 目撃証言 is a witness's account, often in court.
供述 is a statement given to police or prosecutors (by suspect or witness).

cards.d: 写真やカメラ、画面などに写し出された絵や姿。
s: 注目されているのは、マリーナ近くの防犯カメラに残っていた画像だ。
画像
Attention is focused on images left on a security camera near the marina.
スマホで撮った画像を、メールで送ってください。
画像
Please email me the picture you took on your phone.
cf: 映像 is moving footage/video; 画像 is a still image.
写真 is a photograph; 画像 covers any digital image, including screenshots and graphics.

cards.g: death-row inmate; prisoner sentenced to death
cards.d: 死刑の判決が確定し、刑が行われるのを待っている人。
s: 1983年の免田事件では、死刑囚として初めて再審無罪が確定している。
死刑囚
In the 1983 Menda case, a death-row inmate was acquitted at retrial for the first time, and the acquittal became final.
その死刑囚は、逮捕から四十年以上たった今も無実を訴えている。
死刑囚
More than forty years after his arrest, that death-row prisoner still maintains his innocence.
cf: 受刑者 is a prisoner serving a sentence; a 死刑囚 is not technically serving a prison term.
囚人 is a general, somewhat old-fashioned word for prisoner.
cards.note: Neutral legal/news term. Japan has had several retrial acquittals of death-row inmates since 1983 (免田事件 was the first).

cards.d: 結果や判断をはっきり決めてしまうほど、大きな意味を持つさま。
s: 警視庁は専門家に画像の鑑定を依頼したが、解像度が低く、人物を特定する決定的な材料にはなっていない。
決定的
The police asked experts to analyse the images, but the resolution is low and they have not provided anything conclusive to identify the person.
記者は二人が握手する決定的瞬間をカメラに収めた。
決定的
The reporter captured the decisive moment of the two shaking hands.
cf: 致命的 is fatal, ruinous (致命的なミス); 決定的 is decisive either way.
確定的 means virtually certain/settled (当選が確定的); 決定的 stresses that something decides the outcome.

cards.d: 東京都を受け持つ警察の本部。
s: 同僚から連絡を受けた家族が行方不明者届を出し、警視庁も神奈川県警と連携して行方を追っている。
警視庁
After hearing from a colleague, his family filed a missing-person report, and the Tokyo Metropolitan Police are also tracing him in cooperation with Kanagawa police.
警視庁は、特殊詐欺グループの男五人を逮捕したと発表した。
警視庁
The Tokyo Metropolitan Police announced the arrest of five men from a phone-fraud ring.
cf: 警察庁 is the National Police Agency, which oversees police nationally; 警視庁 is Tokyo's own force.
Other prefectures have 県警/府警/道警; Tokyo's force alone is called 警視庁.
cards.note: Its head is the 警視総監. 'Scotland Yard'-style nickname: 桜田門.

cards.d: 二人以上で悪いことをしようと、ひそかに相談すること。
s: 警視庁は、男三人が共謀し、台車を使って商品を運び出していたとみて、窃盗の疑いで立件した。
共謀
The Tokyo police built a theft case, believing the three men had conspired to wheel the goods out on a hand cart.
二人は共謀して、会社の金を横領した疑いが持たれている。
共謀
The two are suspected of conspiring to embezzle company funds.
cf: 共犯 is being an accomplice/the accomplice; 共謀 is the plotting together.
結託 is collusion in general (業者と結託する), less legal-sounding than 共謀.
cards.note: Standard news formula: 「～と共謀し、…した疑い」.

cards.d: お金や品物など、持ち主にとって値打ちのある物。
s: 刑法は「他人の財物を窃取した者」を窃盗罪に問うと定めており、罰則は決して軽くない。
財物
The Penal Code makes 'a person who steals the property of another' guilty of theft, and the penalties are by no means light.
強盗とは、暴行や脅迫によって他人の財物を奪う犯罪だ。
財物
Robbery is the crime of taking another person's property by violence or threats.
cf: 財産 is one's assets/estate as a whole; 財物 is the concrete things (money, goods) a crime targets.
財宝 is treasure, valuables; 財物 is a dry legal term.
cards.note: Mostly seen in statute text and legal explanations (刑法235条).

cards.g: penalty; penal provisions (of a law or rule)
cards.d: 決まりを破った人に、どんな罰を与えるかを定めた規則。
s: 刑法は「他人の財物を窃取した者」を窃盗罪に問うと定めており、罰則は決して軽くない。
罰則
The Penal Code makes 'a person who steals the property of another' guilty of theft, and the penalties are by no means light.
新しい条例には罰則がないため、効果を疑う声もある。
罰則
Because the new ordinance carries no penalties, some doubt it will work.
cf: 罰金 is a fine — one kind of penalty; 罰則 is the provision that sets penalties.
処罰 is the act of punishing someone; 罰則 is the rule.
cards.note: Source gloss 'penal code' is misleading: the Penal Code is 刑法. 罰則 = the penalty clauses in any law, ordinance or rulebook.

cards.d: 人の行動や物事が進むのを、わざとじゃますること。
s: 捜査関係者の間では、証言をさせまいとする何者かの妨害があった可能性を指摘する声もある。
妨害
Some investigators point to the possibility of interference by someone trying to keep him from testifying.
夜中の工事の音が安眠妨害だと、住民が苦情を言った。
妨害
Residents complained that the late-night construction noise was disturbing their sleep.
cf: 邪魔 is the everyday word ('in the way'); 妨害 is deliberate obstruction, often legal/news.
阻害 is impeding something abstract (成長を阻害する), not necessarily deliberate.
cards.note: Fixed compounds: 公務執行妨害 (obstructing an officer), 威力業務妨害, 電波妨害 (jamming).

cards.d: あまりにひどくて、言葉で言い表せないほどであること。
s: 森川さんの上司は「もし誰かが彼を脅していたのなら、言語道断だ」と憤る。
言語道断
His boss is furious: "If someone was threatening him, it is outrageous."
お酒を飲んで車を運転するなんて、言語道断だ。
言語道断
Driving after drinking is simply inexcusable.
cf: もってのほか is a near-synonym ('out of the question'), slightly softer and more conversational.
論外 is 'not even worth discussing'; less moral outrage.
cards.note: Read ごんご, not げんご. Originally a Buddhist phrase (truth beyond words); now pure condemnation. Works as na-adj or noun (言語道断だ).

cards.g: entering (a new phase); storming, rushing into
cards.d: 勢いよく中へ入りこむこと。また、新しい段階に入ること。
s: 手がかりがつかめないまま、捜索は四日目に突入した。
突入
With no leads found, the search has entered its fourth day.
機動隊が、立てこもり犯のいる建物に突入した。
突入
Riot police stormed the building where the barricaded suspect was.
cf: 突撃 is a military charge at the enemy; 突入 is forcing one's way in, or plunging into a phase.
乱入 is barging in disorderly (ファンが乱入).
cards.note: Very common in news for time phases: 〇日目に突入, 夏休みに突入, 解散総選挙に突入.

cards.d: 物事をするのが、とてもすばやいこと。
s: 海上保安部の担当者は「関係機関と連携し、迅速に捜索を進めたい」と話す。
迅速
A Coast Guard official says, "We want to work with the other agencies and push the search forward swiftly."
この店はクレームへの対応が迅速で、感心した。
迅速
I was impressed by how quickly this shop dealt with my complaint.
cf: 速やか(に) stresses doing it without delay, typical in requests and instructions; 迅速 stresses speed of execution (迅速な対応).
敏速 is quick and nimble in movement; rarer.

cards.d: 時間をおかずに、すぐに行うさま。
s: 警視庁は、日曜日の午後にマリーナ周辺で森川さんを見かけた人に対し、速やかに情報を寄せるよう呼びかけている。
速やか
The Tokyo police are calling on anyone who saw Mr. Morikawa around the marina on Sunday afternoon to come forward promptly.
揺れがおさまったら、速やかに建物の外へ避難してください。
速やか
Once the shaking stops, evacuate the building immediately.
cf: 迅速 emphasises speed of action; 速やかに means 'without delay', the standard word in announcements and legal texts.
cards.note: Almost always used adverbially as 速やかに, especially in official instructions and statutes.

cards.g: massing; gathering in one place (forces, ships, people)
cards.d: 人や船、車などが、一つの場所に大勢集まること。
s: 三浦半島の港には、海上保安庁や警察、消防の関係者が集結し、捜索範囲を東京湾の入り口付近まで広げている。
集結
Coast Guard, police and fire personnel have massed at ports on the Miura Peninsula, widening the search to near the mouth of Tokyo Bay.
決勝の舞台に、全国から強豪チームが集結した。
集結
Top teams from across the country gathered for the final.
cf: 終結 (also しゅうけつ) means ending, conclusion (戦争の終結) — homophone, easy to mistype.
結集 is pooling strength or wisdom (力を結集する); 集結 is physically gathering.

title.ja: 議事堂の一日 — 国会・皇室・会見
title.en: A day at the Diet: parliament, the imperial house, press conferences

cards.g: new system; new setup; new leadership lineup
cards.d: 組織や国などで、新しく作り直された仕組みや顔ぶれ。
s: 午後の会見で、首相はまず先週発足した党の新体制について「若手を積極的に登用した」と説明した。
新体制
At the afternoon press conference, the prime minister first explained the party's new leadership, launched last week, saying he had actively promoted younger members.
四月から新体制となった営業部は、まだ少し手探りの状態だ。
新体制
The sales department, reorganized in April, is still finding its feet.
cf: Homophone しんたいせい: 'embodiment, physicality' (philosophy, cognitive science). Context always decides.
cards.note: Everyday news word for a reshuffled lineup or structure of a party, company, team or government. Historically 新体制運動 was the 1940 movement under Prime Minister Konoe.

cards.g: prime minister; premier; chancellor (of Germany, Austria)
cards.d: 内閣の一番上に立ち、国の政治を率いる人。
s: この日は、衆議院本会議で重要な法案の採決が予定されていたうえ、夕方には首相の記者会見も控えていたからだ。
首相
That was because a vote on an important bill was scheduled in the plenary session of the House of Representatives, and the prime minister's press conference was coming up in the evening.
隣の国では首相が辞任し、新しい内閣が発足した。
首相
In the neighboring country the prime minister resigned and a new cabinet was formed.
cf: 総理/総理大臣 is the formal or spoken form (official title 内閣総理大臣; in the Diet you hear 総理). 首相 is the standard newspaper word, and it is also used for foreign heads of government.
cards.note: Headlines prefer 首相. It is also used for the German or Austrian Chancellor (ドイツの首相).

cards.g: the National Diet (Japan's parliament); parliament, congress
cards.d: 選挙で選ばれた議員が集まり、法律や予算を決める国の機関。
s: 午前九時、国会議事堂の周辺には報道陣が詰めかけていた。
国会
At 9 a.m., reporters were crowding around the National Diet Building.
「今の国会で決めるのは無理じゃないかな」と父はテレビを見ながら言った。
国会
"I doubt they can settle it in this Diet session," my father said while watching TV.
cf: 議会 is any assembly (prefectural, city, foreign). 国会 is the national legislature, specifically Japan's Diet when no country is named.
cards.note: The Diet has two houses: 衆議院 (House of Representatives) and 参議院 (House of Councillors). 今国会 (こんこっかい) means 'the current session'.

cards.g: approval, passage (of a bill or motion)
cards.d: 会議で、出された案をよいと認めて決めること。
s: それでも与党と野党が修正協議で歩み寄り、正午過ぎ、法案は賛成多数で可決された。
可決
Even so, the ruling and opposition parties met halfway in talks on amendments, and shortly after noon the bill passed by a majority.
マンションの管理組合の総会で、エレベーター修理の案が可決された。
可決
At the condo owners' general meeting, the proposal to repair the elevator was approved.
cf: A bill is 可決 by one house, and it becomes 成立 (enacted) once both houses have passed it.
Opposite of 可決: the motion is voted down. 採決 is the act of voting.
cards.note: Typically passive in news: 可決された. The headline formula is 〜法が可決・成立.

cards.d: ほかの人やものが去ったあとも、その場や組織にとどまること。
s: 当の議員は会見の後、記者団に「党に残留して、内側から変えていきたい」と語った。
残留
After the press conference, the lawmaker in question told reporters, "I'll stay in the party and try to change it from within."
J1残留をかけた最終戦に、サポーターが大勢詰めかけた。
残留
Fans packed the stadium for the final match, with the team's place in J1 on the line.
野菜に残留する農薬の基準が見直された。
残留
The limits on pesticide residues in vegetables were revised.
cf: 在留 (ざいりゅう) means residing abroad or in Japan as a foreigner (在留資格, 在留外国人). 残留 means staying behind when others leave.
Opposite in party or league contexts: 離脱 means leaving, 残留 means staying.
cards.note: Used in sport for avoiding relegation (残留争い), in politics for staying in a party or bloc, and in science for residues (残留放射能).

cards.d: 天皇の一族として、皇室に属する人々。
s: 実際、ここ数十年の間に何人もの女性皇族が結婚を機に皇籍を離れ、皇族の数は減り続けている。
皇族
In fact, several female members of the imperial family have left it on marrying over recent decades, and the number of imperial family members keeps falling.
皇族の方々が被災地を訪れ、住民を励まされた。
皇族
Members of the imperial family visited the disaster area and encouraged the residents.
cf: 皇室 is the imperial house as an institution, including the Emperor. 皇族 are its members; under the Imperial House Law the Emperor himself is not counted as a 皇族.
cards.note: News speaks about the imperial family in honorific language (励まされた, お出ましになる).

cards.g: leaving, withdrawal, breakaway (from a group or alliance)
cards.d: それまで入っていた組織や集まりから抜けること。
s: 記者の質問は、党を離脱するとみられていた議員が一転してとどまることを決めた件にも及んだ。
離脱
Reporters' questions also touched on the lawmaker who had been expected to leave the party but suddenly decided to stay.
イギリスのEU離脱は、世界経済にも大きな影響を与えた。
離脱
Britain's exit from the EU had a big impact on the global economy as well.
cf: 脱退 is formally quitting an organization or treaty you belonged to. 離脱 is broader: also breaking away from a front line (戦線離脱) or a course, and medical 離脱症状 (withdrawal symptoms).
cards.note: Brexit = 英国のEU離脱. A female imperial family member leaving the family on marriage is 皇籍離脱.

cards.g: the Imperial Household; the imperial family (as an institution)
cards.d: 天皇とその一族をまとめていう言葉。
s: 皇室の将来をどう描くかは、国のかたちにもかかわる問題だ。
皇室
How to envision the future of the imperial family is a question that bears on the very shape of the nation.
皇室に関するニュースは、海外でも関心を集めることが多い。
皇室
News about the imperial family often draws interest abroad as well.
cf: 皇族 are the individual members; 皇室 is the house as a whole.
王室 is used for foreign royal families (イギリス王室). 皇室 is used for Japan's imperial house.
cards.note: 皇室典範 (the Imperial House Law, 1947) governs succession and membership.

cards.g: to fear for; to have misgivings about (whether something will happen)
cards.d: うまくいかないのではないかと心配する。
s: こうした状況から、安定的な皇位継承を危ぶむ声は以前から根強い。
危ぶむ
Given this situation, concern over whether a stable imperial succession can be secured has long been strong.
雨が続き、明日の運動会の開催が危ぶまれている。
危ぶまれ
With the rain continuing, people fear tomorrow's sports day may not go ahead.
cf: 危うい is an adjective (dangerous, precarious). 危ぶむ is the verb: to worry that something is at risk.
案じる is to worry about someone's welfare (身を案じる). 危ぶむ doubts whether something will succeed or survive.
cards.note: Very common in the passive 危ぶまれる ('is in doubt'). Rare in casual speech; people say 心配だ instead.

cards.d: 父から子へと、父方の血筋をたどって続く家系。
s: 現行の皇室典範は、皇位を継ぐのは「皇統に属する男系の男子」に限ると定めている。
男系
The current Imperial House Law limits succession to the throne to 'males in the male line belonging to the imperial lineage'.
その老舗は、代々男系で家業を受け継いできた。
男系
That long-established shop has been handed down through the male line for generations.
cf: 女系 is descent traced through the mother. A 女性天皇 (female emperor) is not the same as a 女系天皇: all eight reigning empresses in history belonged to the male line.
男系 is about lineage, not the person's sex. 男系の男子 means a man whose father's line goes back to the imperial line.
cards.note: Key term in the succession debate. Keep 男系/女系 (lineage) separate from 男性/女性 (sex).

cards.d: 亡くなった人の財産や権利を、家族などが受け継ぐこと。
s: 採決されるのは、親から相続した空き家の管理を所有者に促す法案である。
相続
The bill being voted on urges owners to look after empty houses they have inherited from their parents.
「祖母の家、誰が相続するかで親戚がもめてるらしいよ」
相続
"Apparently the relatives are fighting over who inherits Grandma's house."
cf: 継承 is succession to a title, position or tradition. The throne is 皇位継承, never 相続.
cards.note: Source gloss lists 'succession', but in modern Japanese 相続 is almost always legal inheritance of property. For succession to a position, use 継承.

cards.g: provision, stipulation (in a law or rule); to stipulate
cards.d: 決まりとして、内容をはっきり定めること。また、その定め。
s: さらに、女性の皇族が皇族以外の人と結婚した場合は皇族の身分を離れるという規定もある。
規定
There is also a provision that a female member of the imperial family who marries someone outside it leaves imperial status.
規定の時間を過ぎたので、受付はもう締め切られていた。
規定
The set time had passed, so registration was already closed.
cf: Same reading. 規程 is an organization's set of internal rules as a whole (就業規程). 規定 is an individual provision, or the act of stipulating.
既定 (きてい) means 'already decided' (既定路線, 既定の方針).
cards.note: 規定の〜 also means 'the prescribed/standard ~' (規定の用紙). Three homophones (規定/規程/既定) are worth keeping apart.

cards.d: 一九五五年にできた日本の政党、自由民主党を短くした呼び名。
s: 自民党を含む各党の立ち位置には微妙な違いがあり、合意への道筋はまだ見えていない。
自民党
The positions of the parties, the LDP included, differ in subtle ways, and there is still no clear path to agreement.
祖父は若いころから、ずっと自民党に投票してきたそうだ。
自民党
I hear my grandfather has voted LDP ever since he was young.
cf: 民主党 was a separate party (1996–2016) that held power from 2009 to 2012. Don't mix it up with the 自由民主党 (LDP).
cards.note: Short for 自由民主党, formed in 1955. Its leader is the 総裁 (president), not 党首.

cards.g: coexistence side by side; standing in parallel
cards.d: 二つ以上のものが、同じ立場で並んで存在すること。
s: 国会では、この二つの案が並立したまま、各党の協議が続いている。
並立
In the Diet, the two proposals still stand side by side, and talks among the parties continue.
衆議院の選挙には、小選挙区比例代表並立制が採用されている。
並立
House of Representatives elections use a parallel system that combines single-seat districts and proportional representation.
col: 小選挙区比例代表並立制
cf: 両立 is managing two things at once (仕事と育児の両立). 並立 is two things existing side by side, often as competing alternatives.
cards.note: Source gloss 'standing abreast' is literal. In practice the word means coexistence or parallel alternatives, and it is best known from the electoral-system name 並立制 (in place since the 1994 reform).

cards.g: deliberation (of a bill or proposal by a formal body)
cards.d: 会議で案の中身をくわしく話し合い、よいかどうかを考えること。
s: 審議の過程では、所有者の負担が重すぎるとの指摘も出た。
審議
During the deliberations, some pointed out that the burden on owners was too heavy.
この件は、来週の委員会で改めて審議される予定です。
審議
This matter is scheduled to be deliberated again at next week's committee meeting.
cf: 検討 is examining or considering something in general. 審議 is formal deliberation by a body such as the Diet or a council.
審査 is screening or judging (入学審査). 審議 is discussion leading to a decision.
cards.note: 審議会 = government advisory council. 審議拒否 = the opposition boycotting deliberations.

cards.d: 決まった場で人と会うこと。特に、記者に向けて話す場。
s: 会見では、皇室をめぐる質問も相次いだ。
会見
There was also a string of questions about the imperial family at the press conference.
優勝した選手は、試合後の会見で涙を見せた。
会見
The winner was in tears at the post-match press conference.
cf: 会談 is talks between leaders or officials. 会見 is mainly facing the press, or a formal audience.
面会 is visiting or meeting someone (in hospital, prison or an office).
cards.note: On its own in news, 会見 almost always means 記者会見 (press conference).

cards.d: 県の予算や条例を決める、県民が選んだ議員の集まり。
s: 同じころ、北陸のある県では県議会の定例会が開かれていた。
県議会
Around the same time, a prefecture in the Hokuriku region was holding the regular session of its prefectural assembly.
「うちのおじさん、今度の県議会選挙に出るんだって」
県議会
"Apparently my uncle is running in the next prefectural assembly election."
cf: 都議会・道議会・府議会
Tokyo, Hokkaido, Osaka and Kyoto use 都議会, 道議会 and 府議会. The other 43 prefectures use 県議会.
市議会 is the city council.
cards.note: Members are colloquially 県議 (けんぎ).

cards.g: regular, routine (meeting or session held on a fixed schedule)
cards.d: いつも決まった時期に行うことになっているもの。
s: 定例会の最終日には、関連する意見書の採決も予定されている。
定例
A vote on a related written opinion is also scheduled for the last day of the regular session.
毎週月曜の朝は、部署の定例ミーティングがある。
定例
Every Monday morning there is the department's regular meeting.
cf: 恒例 is a custom or annual tradition (毎年恒例の花火大会). 定例 is a meeting held on a fixed schedule.
Opposite: 定例会 is a regular session, 臨時会 an extraordinary one.
cards.note: Local assemblies hold 定例会 (usually four a year). The national Diet's equivalent is 通常国会.

cards.d: 向かい合っている二つの側の、どちらも。
s: 再稼働に賛成・反対双方の議員から質問が相次ぎ、議場は夕方まで緊張に包まれた。
双方
Questions came one after another from members both for and against the restart, and the chamber stayed tense until evening.
事故の原因については、双方の言い分が食い違っている。
双方
On the cause of the accident, the two sides' accounts contradict each other.
cf: 両方 is everyday 'both' for any two things (両方ほしい). 双方 is for two parties facing each other in talks, disputes or trade.
cards.note: Formal. In speech 両方 or お互い is more common.

cards.g: naturally, of course, as one would expect
cards.d: 言うまでもなく、そうなるのが当たり前だが。
s: 当然ながら、週明けに予定されている国会の委員会の日程にも影響が出るかもしれない。
当然ながら
Naturally, it may also affect the schedule of the Diet committee meetings planned for early next week.
当然ながら、練習しなければ上手にはならない。
当然ながら
Needless to say, you won't get better without practice.
cf: もちろん is neutral and very common in speech. 当然ながら is more written and stresses that the result follows logically.
cards.note: ながら here means 'although/while' (as in 残念ながら). The longer form 当然のことながら is also common in writing.

cards.d: 話や文章の中で、あることに触れること。
s: 首相は「静かな環境の中で、丁寧に議論を進めるべきだ」と述べ、具体的な制度への言及は避けた。
言及
The prime minister said the discussion 'should proceed carefully in a calm environment', and avoided referring to any specific system.
先生は授業で、この小説の結末にも少しだけ言及した。
言及
In class, the teacher briefly mentioned the novel's ending too.
cf: 触れる is the everyday way to say 'touch on' a topic. 言及 is the formal noun, typical of news and academic writing.
cards.note: Typical news pattern: 〜への言及は避けた ('declined to comment on ~').

cards.g: report; informing someone (of results or news)
cards.d: 起きたことや調べたことを、関係する人に知らせること。
s: 知事は、電力会社から安全対策工事が完了したとの報告を受けたことを明らかにした。
報告
The governor revealed that the power company had reported that the safety upgrade work was complete.
「実は来月結婚することになりました」と、友人から報告があった。
報告
A friend let me know, 'Actually, I'm getting married next month.'
cf: 報道 is news coverage by the media. 報告 is informing the people concerned (a boss, an authority, friends).
連絡 is getting in touch or passing on information. 報告 reports results or what happened.
cards.note: Part of the workplace mantra 報連相 (報告・連絡・相談). Announcing personal news (marriage, a pass) is also ご報告.

cards.d: 飛行機などから爆弾を落として、空から攻撃すること。
s: 夜のニュースは、中東のある国で起きた空爆により多くの市民が犠牲になったと伝えた。
空爆
The evening news reported that many civilians had been killed in an airstrike in a country in the Middle East.
空爆で家を失った人々が、国境近くの避難所に身を寄せている。
空爆
People who lost their homes in the airstrikes are sheltering near the border.
cf: 空襲 is 'air raid', usually seen from the side being attacked and tied to WWII (東京大空襲). 空爆 is the neutral current-news word.
爆撃 means bombing in general. 空爆 specifies that it comes from the air.
cards.note: Matter-of-fact news vocabulary. 空爆 is also the word for drone strikes (ドローンによる空爆).

cards.r: げんしりょくはつでんしょ
cards.d: 核分裂で生まれる熱を使って電気を作る施設。
s: 焦点は、県内にある原子力発電所の再稼働をめぐる問題だ。
原子力発電所
The focus is the question of restarting the nuclear power plant in the prefecture.
海沿いの原子力発電所では、毎年定期検査が行われている。
原子力発電所
Regular inspections are carried out every year at the seaside nuclear power plant.
cf: 火力発電所 is a thermal (fossil-fuel) power plant. 水力 means hydro, 風力 wind.
cards.note: Almost always shortened to 原発 in speech and headlines. 発電所 is read はつでんしょ, though はつでんじょ is also widely heard.

cards.d: 北の方角へ向かって進むこと。
s: 気象庁によると、大型の台風十四号は沖縄の南の海上を北上している。
北上
According to the Japan Meteorological Agency, the large Typhoon No. 14 is moving north over the sea south of Okinawa.
桜前線は、三月下旬から少しずつ北上していく。
北上
The cherry-blossom front gradually moves north from late March.
cf: Same kanji, read きたかみ: a city and river in Iwate (北上川).
cards.note: Standard weather-report verb (北上する). Also used for travel or migration northward.

cards.g: position, role relative to others; (lit.) where one stands
cards.d: その人や組織が、周りとの関係の中でしめる場所や役割。
s: 自民党を含む各党の立ち位置には微妙な違いがあり、合意への道筋はまだ見えていない。
立ち位置
The positions of the parties, the LDP included, differ in subtle ways, and there is still no clear path to agreement.
舞台の上で、自分の立ち位置を間違えないように床に印をつけた。
立ち位置
I put a mark on the stage floor so I wouldn't stand in the wrong place.
cf: 立場 is a formal standpoint or position, often carrying responsibility (立場上). 立ち位置 is more casual and relational: where you fit compared with others.
cards.note: Originally a stage or TV term for an actor's mark. The figurative sense (one's role in a group) is now very common in conversation and commentary.

title.ja: 橋が落ちた日 — 公共工事の検証
title.en: The day the bridge fell: auditing a public works project

modules.passageTitle: 橋が落ちた日 — 浜里町歩道橋崩落、県議会が検証

cards.d: 建物や道路、橋などの工事を、実際に行うこと。
s: 設計は県が委託した建設コンサルタント会社が、施工は地元の建設会社が担当した。
施工
The design was handled by a consulting firm commissioned by the prefecture, and the construction by a local builder.
このマンションは、大手ゼネコンが施工を手がけた。
施工
This condominium was built by a major general contractor.
cf: 施行 (しこう, also せこう) = putting a law into effect; the construction industry says せこう for 施工 partly to keep them apart.
竣工 = completion of construction; 施工 = the construction work itself.
cards.note: しこう is also a dictionary reading of 施工, but in practice せこう dominates.

cards.d: 物を作る前に、形やしくみ、大きさなどを考えて図などに表すこと。
s: 設計は県が委託した建設コンサルタント会社が、施工は地元の建設会社が担当した。
設計
The design was handled by a consulting firm commissioned by the prefecture, and the construction by a local builder.
若いうちから、人生設計をしっかり考えておいたほうがいい。
設計
You'd better think your life plan through while you're young.
cf: 計画 = a plan of action/schedule; 設計 = designing a structure or system (also figurative: 人生設計, 制度設計).
デザイン leans toward appearance/style; 設計 toward structure and engineering.
cards.note: Figurative uses (人生設計, 制度設計) are very common in news and conversation.

cards.g: collapse, cave-in (of a structure, slope, ceiling)
cards.d: 崖や建物の一部などが、くずれて落ちること。
s: 今年3月、浜里町の駅前で県道をまたぐ歩道橋が崩落した。
崩落
This March, a footbridge spanning the prefectural road in front of Hamasato Station collapsed.
大雨の影響で山道の斜面が崩落し、通行止めになっている。
崩落
Heavy rain caused the slope along the mountain road to give way, and it is closed to traffic.
cf: 倒壊 = a building toppling over; 崩落 = something crumbling and falling down.
崩壊 = collapse in general, incl. abstract (体制の崩壊); 崩落 is physical falling.
cards.note: Typical news word for bridges, tunnels, ceilings and cliffs. The '(market) decline' sense in the source gloss is rare.

cards.d: 建物や設備の傷んだところを直すためにかかるお金。
s: 訴額は約4億2千万円で、橋の撤去費や仮設通路の設置費のほか、崩落で傷んだ県道や信号機の修繕費も含まれている。
修繕費
The claim amount is about 420 million yen and includes, besides demolition and a temporary walkway, the cost of repairing the road and traffic lights damaged in the collapse.
古いマンションは修繕費がかさみ、住民の負担が増えている。
修繕費
In older condos, repair costs pile up and residents' burden keeps growing.
cf: 修理費 = fixing a broken machine/car/device; 修繕費 = repairing buildings and facilities, also an accounting term.
cards.note: Standard term in real estate and accounting (修繕費 vs 資本的支出).

cards.d: 細かいところまで、くわしく調べること。
s: ある委員は「新しい橋の建設費のうち、どこまでが崩落による損害と言えるのか、精査が必要だ」と指摘した。
精査
One member pointed out, 'We need to scrutinize how much of the cost of the new bridge can be called damage caused by the collapse.'
いただいた書類を精査したうえで、改めてご連絡いたします。
精査
We will contact you again after carefully reviewing the documents you sent.
cf: 審査 = judging/screening against criteria (入学審査); 精査 = examining closely.
調査 = investigation/survey in general; 精査 stresses thoroughness.
cards.note: Business and political stock phrase: 精査したうえで回答する is a polite way to delay an answer.

cards.g: amount in controversy; value of a lawsuit's claim
cards.d: 裁判で相手に求める金額など、訴えの対象の価値を金額で表したもの。
s: 委員会では、この訴額の妥当性をめぐって質問が相次いだ。
訴額
In committee, one question after another was raised about whether the claim amount was justified.
訴額が140万円を超える民事訴訟は、地方裁判所で扱われる。
訴額
