Civil suits where the amount in controversy exceeds 1.4 million yen are heard in district court.
cf: 請求額 = the amount demanded (any bill or claim); news often uses it for lawsuits. 訴額 is the legal term that sets court fees and jurisdiction.
cards.note: Legal jargon (short for 訴訟物の価額). Determines filing fees (印紙代) and which court hears the case.

cards.d: 考えや判断、数字などが、その場合に合っていて正しいと言える度合い。
s: 委員会では、この訴額の妥当性をめぐって質問が相次いだ。
妥当性
In committee, one question after another was raised about whether the claim amount was justified.
この調査方法の妥当性については、専門家の間でも意見が分かれている。
妥当性
Experts are divided over the validity of this research method.
cf: 正当性 = legitimacy/justification (right or wrong); 妥当性 = whether it is reasonable/fitting.
In statistics, 妥当性 = validity and 信頼性 = reliability.
cards.note: Source gloss lists 'verification', which is misleading: 妥当性 is the quality being checked (validity), not the act of checking (検証).

cards.d: 言葉や文章、数字などの間違いを、正しく直すこと。
s: しかし計算に誤りがあり、県は今月、これを「約2度」に訂正した。
訂正
However, the calculation contained an error, and this month the prefecture corrected the figure to 'about 2 degrees.'
先ほどの発言を、一部訂正させていただきます。
訂正
Allow me to partly correct what I said a moment ago.
col: 訂正してお詫びします
cf: 修正 = adjusting/amending (plans, drafts) even when not wrong; 訂正 = fixing a mistake.
改訂 = revising a book/edition (改訂版).
cards.note: Newspapers end correction notices with 訂正しておわびします.

cards.d: 何かをする前に、あらかじめそろえたり済ませたりしなければならないこと。
s: ただし、自治体が訴訟を起こすには、議会の議決が事前に必要となる。
事前に必要
However, before a local government can file a lawsuit, it needs a vote by the assembly.
このセミナーの受講に事前に必要な知識は、特にありません。
事前に必要
No prior knowledge is required to take this seminar.
cf: 前提条件 or 履修条件 is the actual noun for 'prerequisite' (e.g. for a course).
cards.note: Not a lexicalized word, just 事前に + 必要. 'Prerequisite' is a loose gloss; translate by context.

cards.g: circulation/flow planning (how people move through a space)
cards.d: 建物や町の中を人や物がどう動くかを考えて、通り道を決めること。
s: 駅の改札と商店街、そして高台の住宅地を立体的に結ぶ構造で、駅前再開発の動線計画の要とされてきた。
動線計画
Linking the ticket gates, the shopping street and the hillside housing in three dimensions, it was seen as the linchpin of the station-area redevelopment's pedestrian flow plan.
家事を楽にするには、キッチンと洗面所の動線計画が大切だ。
動線計画
To make housework easier, planning the routes between kitchen and washroom is key.
cf: Homophone どうせん: 導線 = electrical lead wire; often mis-typed for 動線 'circulation path'.
cards.note: Architecture/urban-planning term. The source gloss ran two glosses together; 動線 alone (家事動線, 生活動線) is common in home-design talk.

cards.d: 高さや奥行きがあるようす。物事をいろいろな面から見るようす。
s: 駅の改札と商店街、そして高台の住宅地を立体的に結ぶ構造で、駅前再開発の動線計画の要とされてきた。
立体的
Linking the ticket gates, the shopping street and the hillside housing in three dimensions, it was seen as the linchpin of the station-area redevelopment's pedestrian flow plan.
この画家は、影を使って物を立体的に見せるのがうまい。
立体的
This painter is good at using shadows to make objects look three-dimensional.
cf: 多角的 = from many angles (analysis); 立体的 in the figurative sense is close but more visual.
cards.note: Related: 立体交差 (grade-separated crossing), 立体駐車場 (multi-storey car park).

cards.d: 地面に対してまっすぐ立っていること。線や面が直角に交わること。
s: その結果、本来は垂直に立っているべき橋脚が、川側へ約2度傾いていたことが分かった。
垂直
As a result, it emerged that a pier that should have stood vertical was leaning about 2 degrees toward the river.
点Cを通り、直線ABに垂直な直線を引きなさい。
垂直
Draw a line through point C perpendicular to line AB.
cf: 鉛直 = strictly along the direction of gravity (physics/surveying); 垂直 also covers 'perpendicular to any line or plane'.
直角 = a right angle itself; 垂直 = the relationship of meeting at one.
cards.note: Opposite: 水平. Business jargon: 垂直統合 'vertical integration'.

cards.d: 点の位置を、基準からの数の組で表したもの。
s: さらにレーザー測量で数千か所の座標を求め、座標幾何学の手法で構造全体のゆがみを計算した。
座標
They then obtained coordinates for thousands of points by laser survey and calculated the distortion of the whole structure using coordinate geometry.
地図アプリで、待ち合わせ場所の座標を友達に送った。
座標
I sent my friend the coordinates of our meeting spot from my map app.
cards.note: Math/surveying/GPS word. 座標軸 is also used figuratively for a frame of reference.

cards.d: 図形を数や式で表し、計算によって性質を調べる数学の分野。
s: さらにレーザー測量で数千か所の座標を求め、座標幾何学の手法で構造全体のゆがみを計算した。
座標幾何学
They then obtained coordinates for thousands of points by laser survey and calculated the distortion of the whole structure using coordinate geometry.
座標幾何学を使えば、図形の問題を計算だけで解くことができる。
座標幾何学
With coordinate geometry, you can solve geometry problems by calculation alone.
cf: Same field; 解析幾何学 is the far more common name in Japanese.
cards.note: Fairly rare term; Japanese school math calls this 図形と方程式 and academics say 解析幾何学.

cards.g: each part; every section (of a whole)
cards.d: 全体をつくっている、それぞれの部分。
s: 崩落を受けて県が設けた調査委員会は、まず崩れ残った橋脚や橋桁など各部の状態を一つずつ記録した。
各部
The investigative committee set up after the collapse first recorded the condition of each surviving part, such as piers and girders, one by one.
この説明書では、各部の名称と働きを図で紹介しています。
各部
This manual uses diagrams to show the name and function of each part.
cf: For 'each department' of an organization, 各部署 or 各部門 is more usual than 各部.
cards.note: Typical of manuals and reports. Pattern: 各 + noun = each (各国, 各地, 各自).

cards.g: up and down; top and bottom; rising and falling; both directions
cards.d: 上と下。上がったり下がったりすること。行きと帰りの両方向。
s: 「強い風の日には橋が上下に揺れる」という住民の声も、町には以前から寄せられていたという。
上下
Residents had reportedly been telling the town for some time that 'on windy days the bridge bounces up and down.'
事故の影響で、新幹線は上下線とも運転を見合わせている。
上下
Because of the accident, shinkansen services are suspended in both directions.
このところ、気温が大きく上下する日が続いている。
上下
Lately we've had a run of days with big swings in temperature.
cards.note: 上下線 = inbound and outbound lines (rail/road). 上下関係 = hierarchy (senior/junior). The colloquial reading うえした is used for physical top/bottom.

cards.g: to cover; to shroud; to conceal
cards.d: 上からかぶせて、見えないようにしたり守ったりする。
s: 橋脚の根元は化粧板で覆われており、内部のさびは外から見えなかった。
覆わ
The base of the pier was covered with decorative panels, so the rust inside couldn't be seen from outside.
目を覆いたくなるような事故の映像が、何度も流れた。
覆い
Footage of the accident, so awful you'd want to cover your eyes, was shown over and over.
cf: Same kanji, くつがえす = to overturn (a ruling, common sense).
被せる (かぶせる) = to put something on top of; more everyday and hands-on than 覆う.
cards.note: 目を覆う = to be unable to bear looking (目を覆うばかりの惨状). Passive 覆われる is very frequent (雪に覆われた山).

cards.g: incorporation (into a larger body); transfer admission (school)
cards.d: すでにある組織や区分などに、あとから組み入れること。
s: 歩道橋は2010年に町道から県道に編入され、管理者も町から県に移った。
編入
In 2010 the footbridge was reclassified from a town road to a prefectural road, and its management passed from the town to the prefecture.
高専を卒業したあと、大学の三年生に編入した。
編入
After graduating from technical college, I transferred into the third year of university.
cf: 転入 = moving in (residence) or transferring to another school at the same level; 編入 = being incorporated into an existing group/grade.
加入 = joining (insurance, a union) as a member.
cards.note: Municipal mergers: 編入合併 = one town absorbed into another, vs 新設合併 creating a new one.

cards.g: reduction, lightening (of a burden, pain, damage)
cards.d: 負担や痛み、被害などを、減らして軽くすること。
s: 駅前には現在、仮設の横断歩道が設けられ、高齢者の負担を軽減するため誘導員も配置されている。
軽減
A temporary crosswalk has been set up in front of the station, and guides are stationed there to ease the burden on elderly people.
食料品には、消費税の軽減税率が適用されている。
軽減
A reduced consumption-tax rate applies to food.
cf: 削減 = cutting a quantity (costs, staff); 軽減 = lightening a burden or suffering.
cards.note: Very frequent in policy news; the object is almost always something unpleasant (負担, 痛み, 被害, リスク).

cards.g: entering (in a register or list); listing
cards.d: 名簿や台帳などに、名前や項目を書き入れて載せること。
s: しかも、県道への編入後、歩道橋は県の点検台帳に登載されておらず、定期点検が一度も行われていなかった。
登載
Moreover, after the reclassification the footbridge was never entered in the prefecture's inspection register, and not a single routine inspection was carried out.
党は、元市長を比例代表の名簿に登載すると発表した。
登載
The party announced it would put the former mayor on its proportional-representation list.
cf: Homophone とうさい: 搭載 = equipped with/loaded on (AI搭載のスマホ).
掲載 = publishing in a newspaper/magazine/site.
記載 = writing something down in a document.
cards.note: Mostly used for official lists: candidate lists, registers, ledgers.

cards.d: 本当かどうか、正しいかどうかを、調べて確かめること。
s: 委員長は「設計、施工、点検のどこに問題があったのか、徹底的に検証したい」と話す。
検証
The committee chair says, 'We want to examine thoroughly whether the problem lay in design, construction or inspection.'
その説が正しいかどうか、実験で検証してみよう。
検証
Let's test with an experiment whether that theory is right.
cf: 検討 = considering/deliberating on options; 検証 = checking facts or hypotheses against evidence.
検査 = inspection/test (健康診断, product checks).
cards.note: Also a legal term (現場検証 = on-site inspection by police/court).

cards.d: 性能や安全性が予定どおりかどうかを、実際に試して確かめること。
s: これに対し県は、残った橋桁の一部に重りを載せる検証試験を行い、設計どおりの強度があったかを確かめると答えた。
検証試験
In response, the prefecture said it would run a verification test loading weights onto part of the remaining girders to check whether they had the designed strength.
新しい自動運転システムの検証試験が、来月から始まる。
検証試験
Verification testing of the new self-driving system starts next month.
cf: 実証実験 = a pilot/field trial of a new technology in real conditions; 検証試験 = a test confirming specified performance.
cards.note: Engineering/IT term; in medicine the equivalent is 臨床試験.

title.ja: 盤上の神童 — 勝負の言葉
title.en: The prodigy at the board: the language of competition

modules.passageTitle: 盤上の十七歳 — 朝霧湊、初のタイトル挑戦

cards.g: on the board (shogi, go); over the board, in the game itself
cards.d: 将棋や碁の盤の上。また、そこで行われる勝負そのもの。
s: 盤上に駒を置く乾いた音が、ときおりそれに重なる。
盤上
The dry click of pieces being set on the board overlapped it now and then.
盤上の戦いが終われば、二人は仲のいい友人に戻る。
盤上
Once the battle over the board is done, the two go back to being good friends.
cf: 盤面 is the board's surface / the position as a whole you look at; 盤上 is 'on the board' as a place where play happens.
cards.note: Used figuratively for the game as opposed to off-board matters: 盤上の勝負 vs 盤外の駆け引き.

cards.d: 時計で、秒をきざむいちばん細い針。
s: 対局室には、壁の時計の秒針が進む音だけが響いていた。
秒針
In the game room, the only sound was the second hand of the wall clock ticking on.
この腕時計は電池が切れて、秒針が止まっている。
秒針
This watch's battery died, so the second hand has stopped.
cf: 長針 (ちょうしん) is the minute hand; 短針 (たんしん) the hour hand.
秒速 is speed per second, not a clock part.

cards.d: 競争や戦いで相手をおさえ、頂点に立つこと。
s: プロ入りからわずか四年でのトーナメント制覇である。
制覇
It was a tournament win just four years after turning pro.
全国制覇を目標に、部員たちは毎日練習している。
制覇
The club members practise every day with a national title as their goal.
cf: 連覇 (れんぱ) is winning consecutive titles; 制覇 is winning/conquering one.
cards.note: In sports and games news 制覇 almost always just means 'winning the championship'; 'conquest' is the military/historical sense.

cards.g: board position (shogi, go); surface of a board; face of a record/disc
cards.d: 碁や将棋の盤の表面。また、その上の駒や石の並び方と形勢。
s: 対局中の朝霧は、眼前の駒の動きにとらわれず、盤面全体を俯瞰するように見つめる。
盤面
During a game, Asagiri isn't caught up in the moves right in front of him; he gazes at the whole board as if from above.
盤面だけを見れば、先手がやや有利だ。
盤面
Looking at the position alone, Black (the first player) is slightly better.
cf: 盤上 = 'on the board' (where play takes place); 盤面 = the board/position as an object you read.
cards.note: The 'record' sense in the source gloss refers to the face of a vinyl record or disc label; rare compared with the board-game sense.

cards.d: 子どものころから、並外れた才能を見せる子。
s: 朝霧は小学生のころから「神童」と呼ばれてきた。
神童
Asagiri has been called a 'prodigy' since elementary school.
十で神童、十五で才子、二十過ぎればただの人。
神童
A prodigy at ten, a talent at fifteen, and past twenty just an ordinary person.
cf: 天才 is 'genius' at any age; 神童 is specifically a gifted child.
cards.note: The second sentence is a well-known saying warning that early brilliance often fades.

cards.g: to shake; to unsettle, rattle (an opponent); to move (emotionally)
cards.d: 大きくゆり動かす。また、相手の心を乱して動揺させる。
s: 久世九段はあえて定跡を外す手法で若い挑戦者を揺さぶろうとしたが、朝霧の指し手に乱れはなかった。
揺さぶろ
Kuze 9-dan deliberately left standard lines to rattle the young challenger, but Asagiri's moves never wavered.
彼女のスピーチは、会場にいた人々の心を揺さぶった。
揺さぶっ
Her speech moved the hearts of everyone in the hall.
目を覚まさない弟の肩を揺さぶった。
揺さぶっ
I shook my little brother by the shoulders when he wouldn't wake up.
cf: 揺する (ゆする) is a plain physical 'shake/rock'; 揺さぶる is stronger and readily figurative. Note ゆする also = 強請る 'extort'.
cards.note: In baseball, 揺さぶる also means varying pitches or bunts to unsettle the defence.

cards.g: rare, exceptional, unparalleled (of talent, beauty, etc.)
cards.d: 同じようなものがほとんどないほど、すぐれているさま。
s: 朝霧の強さを支えるのは、たぐいまれな読みの力だ。
たぐいまれ
What underpins Asagiri's strength is his exceptional ability to read ahead.
彼女はたぐいまれな美声の持ち主だ。
たぐいまれ
She has a voice of rare beauty.
col: たぐいまれな〜の持ち主
cf: まれ (稀) alone just means 'rare/uncommon' and can be neutral; たぐいまれ is praise.
cards.note: Written 類い稀 / 類稀. Always positive and nearly always attributive (たぐいまれな＋noun).

cards.d: 短い期間に、とくに力を入れて行う練習。
s: 毎朝の走り込みと型の稽古という特訓は、中学を卒業するまで続いたという。
特訓
The intensive training of morning runs and kata practice reportedly continued until he finished junior high.
面接の前に、先輩に敬語を特訓してもらった。
特訓
Before the interview, a senior colleague drilled me intensively in keigo.
cf: 訓練 is ordinary training/drill (also military, emergency drills); 特訓 is special, extra-intense training.
cards.note: Short for 特別訓練; casual and very common (夏休みの特訓, 猛特訓).

cards.g: to not know what to do with; to find too much to handle
cards.d: 扱い方がわからず、どうしたらよいか困る。
s: 元格闘家で、今も屈強な体つきの剛志さんは、幼い湊が有り余る体力を持て余しているのを見て、自分の道場に連れて行った。
持て余し
Takeshi, a former martial artist who is still powerfully built, saw that little Minato had more energy than he knew what to do with, and took him to his own dojo.
定年後の父は、暇を持て余しているようだ。
持て余し
Since retiring, my father seems to have more free time than he knows what to do with.
cards.note: Common with time/energy (暇を持て余す), and with people who are hard to handle (問題児を持て余す).

cards.d: よいかどうか、いろいろな面からよく調べて考えること。
s: 何万もの局面を検討してきた蓄積が、いざという時に形になるのだ。
検討
The accumulation of having studied tens of thousands of positions takes shape when it really counts.
ご提案の件は、社内で前向きに検討いたします。
検討
We will give your proposal positive consideration internally.
cf: 健闘 (same reading) = fighting hard/putting up a good fight. 検討 = examining/considering.
検証 checks whether something is true/correct after the fact; 検討 weighs options or studies something.
cards.note: In shogi coverage 検討 is the analysis of positions (検討室, 感想戦で検討する). In business, 前向きに検討します is often a polite non-commitment.

cards.g: fighting hard, putting up a good fight; strenuous effort
cards.d: 強い相手やつらい状況に負けず、よくがんばって戦うこと。
s: 久世九段は「最後まで健闘されて、こちらもずっと苦しかった」と振り返った。
健闘
Kuze 9-dan looked back: 'He fought hard to the very end, and it was tough for me the whole way.'
皆さんのご健闘をお祈りしています。
健闘
I wish you all the best of luck (in the contest).
cf: Homophone: 検討 = consideration/analysis. 健闘 = a brave, strong effort in a contest.
cards.note: Often said of a loser who did well (健闘むなしく敗れた 'lost despite a valiant effort'). ご健闘をお祈りします is a stock send-off before a competition.

cards.d: 両方の力が同じくらいで、どちらが上とも言えないこと。
s: 第一局は序盤から中盤にかけて互角のまま進んだ。
互角
Game one proceeded evenly from the opening into the middlegame.
経験では負けているが、体力なら互角だ。
互角
I'm behind in experience, but we're even in stamina.
cf: 五分五分 (ごぶごぶ) is casual 'fifty-fifty', also for odds/chances; 互角 is about matched strength.
対等 is equal standing/status (対等な関係); 互角 is equal ability in a contest.

cards.d: 人々が思わず喜ぶような、すばらしい成果や行い。
s: 十代での挑戦は史上二人目の快挙で、挑戦が決まった日には将棋会館に報道陣が詰めかけた。
快挙
A teenage title challenge is a feat achieved only once before in history, and on the day it was decided, reporters crowded into the Shogi Hall.
地元の高校が甲子園初出場という快挙を成し遂げた。
快挙
The local high school pulled off the feat of reaching Koshien for the first time.
cf: 偉業 is a great, historic achievement (often lifelong); 快挙 is a single cheering, newsworthy feat.

cards.g: eminent, distinguished (in そうそうたる顔ぶれ)
cards.d: 多くの中でも特にすぐれていて、名の知れているさま。
s: 挑戦者決定トーナメントにはタイトル経験者を含むそうそうたる顔ぶれが並んだが、朝霧は一局ごとに内容を高めながら勝ち残った。
そうそう
The challenger tournament featured a distinguished line-up including former title holders, but Asagiri survived, raising the quality of his play with each game.
審査員には、業界のそうそうたるメンバーがそろった。
そうそう
The judging panel was made up of leading figures in the industry.
col: そうそうたるメンバー
cf: 早々 (そうそう) = 'early on / right after' (新年早々).
そうそう! = 'right, right!' in conversation; そうそう〜ない = 'not that often'.
cards.note: Kanji 錚々. Used almost exclusively as そうそうたる + noun. The 'ringing of metal' sense in the source gloss is the literal origin and is essentially never met.

cards.g: to win and advance; to survive (a competition)
cards.d: 試合に勝って次に進む。また、競争の中で最後まで残る。
s: 挑戦者決定トーナメントにはタイトル経験者を含むそうそうたる顔ぶれが並んだが、朝霧は一局ごとに内容を高めながら勝ち残った。
勝ち残っ
The challenger tournament featured a distinguished line-up including former title holders, but Asagiri survived, raising the quality of his play with each game.
価格競争に勝ち残った店は、ほんの数軒だけだった。
勝ち残っ
Only a handful of shops survived the price war.
cf: 生き残る is 'to survive' in general (disasters, business); 勝ち残る implies surviving by winning against rivals.

cards.g: to compete, contend for; to quarrel, dispute
cards.d: 相手に勝とうとして張り合う。また、言い合いやけんかをする。
s: 格闘も将棋も、相手と向き合って争う点では同じだというのが剛志さんの考えだった。
争う
Takeshi believed that fighting and shogi are the same in that you face an opponent and contend with them.
祖父の遺産をめぐって、兄弟が裁判で争っている。
争っ
The brothers are fighting in court over their grandfather's estate.
救急の現場では、患者の容体は一刻を争う。
争う
In emergency care, a patient's condition is a race against time.
cf: 競う is friendly competition in skill or quality; 争う covers conflict and quarrels and contesting a single prize/position.
cards.note: Legal register: 争う also means 'to contest/deny' (容疑を争う姿勢). 一刻を争う 'time is of the essence' is very common.

cards.g: to compete, vie (in skill, speed, beauty)
cards.d: 互いに相手より上になろうとして、力や技を比べ合う。
s: 同世代の棋士と競うように腕を磨き、伸び悩んだ時期には兄弟子たちが研究相手として加勢してくれたという。
競う
He honed his skill as if racing his peers, and when he hit a plateau, senior disciples of his teacher stepped in to help as study partners.
庭では、色とりどりの花が美しさを競っている。
競っ
In the garden, colourful flowers vie with each other in beauty.
cf: 争う can be hostile (quarrel, lawsuit); 競う is rivalry in ability, usually without hostility.
cards.note: 競うように 'as if competing' is a common adverbial pattern.

cards.d: いちばんよいこと。また、できるかぎりの努力。
s: それでも彼は、その手が本当に最善かどうかを必ず確かめてから駒を動かす。
最善
Even so, he always checks that the move is truly the best before moving a piece.
最善を尽くしたので、結果がどうでも後悔はない。
最善
I did my very best, so whatever the result, I have no regrets.
cf: 最良 = the best (quality, outcome): 最良の日. 最善 = the best course/effort: 最善を尽くす, 最善の方法.
cards.note: Shogi commentators say 最善手 for 'the best move'.

cards.g: (idea) to flash into one's mind; to flash, gleam; to flutter
cards.d: 考えなどが急に頭にうかぶ。また、光が一瞬ぴかっと光る。
s: 勝負どころでは、次の一手がふっとひらめく瞬間があるという。
ひらめく
At critical moments, he says, there are instants when the next move just flashes into his mind.
シャワーを浴びているときに、いいアイデアがひらめいた。
ひらめい
A good idea came to me while I was in the shower.
遠くの夜空に、稲妻が青白くひらめいた。
ひらめい
Far off in the night sky, lightning flashed a bluish white.
cf: 思いつく is neutral 'think of'; ひらめく stresses a sudden flash of inspiration.
cards.note: Kanji 閃く, but usually written in kana. The noun ひらめき = inspiration, flash of insight.

cards.d: 考えるより先に、体が自然に動いて。
s: 読むより先に、反射的に手が伸びることもあるという。
反射的に
He says that sometimes his hand moves by reflex before he has even read the position.
名前を呼ばれて、反射的に振り返った。
反射的に
When my name was called, I turned around reflexively.
col: 反射的に手を引っ込める
cf: 思わず = involuntarily, in spite of oneself (often emotional); 反射的に = automatic, reflex-like reaction.
cards.note: The source gloss 'reflectively' is misleading: it means 'by reflex', not 'thoughtfully'.

cards.g: bird's-eye view; looking down from above; seeing the big picture
cards.d: 高い所から見下ろすこと。また、物事を全体から広く見ること。
s: 対局中の朝霧は、眼前の駒の動きにとらわれず、盤面全体を俯瞰するように見つめる。
俯瞰
During a game, Asagiri isn't caught up in the moves right in front of him; he gazes at the whole board as if from above.
会議では、細部にこだわらず、全体を俯瞰して考えることが大切だ。
俯瞰
In meetings it's important to step back and see the big picture rather than fixating on details.
cf: 鳥瞰 (ちょうかん) is a near-synonym, mainly in 鳥瞰図; 俯瞰 is far more common, including the figurative 'big picture' sense.
cards.note: Business Japanese loves 俯瞰的に見る 'take a helicopter view'. In film, 俯瞰ショット = high-angle shot.

cards.g: aim, sights (of a gun); target, focus
cards.d: 弾などを当てるために、ねらいを合わせること。また、その目標。
s: 相手の玉に照準を定めてからの寄せは、秒速と形容したくなるほど速い。
照準
Once he has set his sights on the opponent's king, his mating attack is so fast you want to call it lightning.
チームは来年の世界大会に照準を合わせて準備を進めている。
照準
The team is preparing with next year's world championship as its target.
cf: 標準 (ひょうじゅん) = standard/norm; easy to misread for 照準 (しょうじゅん) = aim.
cards.note: Literal use is military/hunting (ライフルの照準); in news it's mostly figurative: 〜に照準を合わせる 'target, gear up for'.

cards.g: to tell apart, distinguish; to judge (quality) by sight
cards.d: 見て、ちがいや良い悪いを区別する。
s: 攻めるべき場所と守るべき場所を見分ける感覚は鋭敏だ。
見分ける
His sense for telling where to attack and where to defend is razor-sharp.
双子なので、親でもなかなか見分けられない。
見分けられ
They're twins, so even their parents can hardly tell them apart.
col: 本物と偽物を見分ける
cf: 見極める = to see through to the essence, determine definitively; 見分ける = to distinguish between things.

cards.d: 感覚や頭の働きがするどく、細かいことにもすぐ気づくさま。
s: 攻めるべき場所と守るべき場所を見分ける感覚は鋭敏だ。
鋭敏
His sense for telling where to attack and where to defend is razor-sharp.
犬は人間よりもはるかに嗅覚が鋭敏だ。
鋭敏
Dogs have a far keener sense of smell than humans.
cf: 敏感 is everyday 'sensitive' and can mean oversensitive (肌が敏感); 鋭敏 is a written, approving 'keen/acute'.

cards.g: before one's eyes, right in front of one
cards.d: 目のすぐ前。
s: 対局中の朝霧は、眼前の駒の動きにとらわれず、盤面全体を俯瞰するように見つめる。
眼前
During a game, Asagiri isn't caught up in the moves right in front of him; he gazes at the whole board as if from above.
山頂に着くと、眼前に雲の海が広がっていた。
眼前
When we reached the summit, a sea of clouds spread out before our eyes.
cf: 目の前 is the everyday equivalent; 眼前 is literary/written.

cards.g: speed per second (e.g. 秒速30m); (colloq.) lightning-fast
cards.d: 一秒の間に進む距離で表した速さ。
s: 相手の玉に照準を定めてからの寄せは、秒速と形容したくなるほど速い。
秒速
Once he has set his sights on the opponent's king, his mating attack is so fast you want to call it lightning.
台風の最大風速は秒速四十メートルに達した。
秒速
The typhoon's maximum wind speed reached 40 metres per second.
cf: 時速 = per hour, 分速 = per minute; 秒速 = per second.
秒針 = a clock's second hand.
cards.note: Source gloss 'per second' is incomplete: 秒速 is a speed measured per second. Casually, 秒速で means 'instantly' (秒速で返信).

cards.g: when it really counts; in an emergency; when push comes to shove
cards.d: 大事なことや危ないことが急に起きたとき。
s: 何万もの局面を検討してきた蓄積が、いざという時に形になるのだ。
いざという時
The accumulation of having studied tens of thousands of positions takes shape when it really counts.
いざという時のために、水と非常食を用意しておこう。
いざという時
Let's keep water and emergency food ready, just in case.
col: いざという時に備える
いざという時のために
いざという時に役立つ
cf: いざとなると/いざとなったら = 'when it actually comes to it' (often about losing nerve or finally acting).
cards.note: Also written いざというとき or いざという場合.

cards.g: graceful, sportsmanlike (in accepting defeat); manly, resolute; pure
cards.d: 未練を残さず、思い切りがよい。また、心が清らかで恥じるところがない。
s: その潔い投了に、控室の棋士たちからも感嘆の声が上がった。
潔い
His graceful resignation drew murmurs of admiration even from the professionals in the waiting room.
彼は言い訳をせず、自分の失敗を潔く認めた。
潔く
He made no excuses and owned up to his mistake like a man.
cards.note: Core idea: accepting a loss or fault cleanly, without clinging. 〜を潔しとしない (literary) = 'to refuse to stoop to ~'.

cards.d: 種類や違いがとても多く、一つ一つがみな異なること。
s: 一口に棋士と言っても、その育ち方は千差万別だ。
千差万別
Pro shogi players may all be called the same thing, but how they develop varies enormously.
同じ料理でも、家庭によって味付けは千差万別だ。
千差万別
Even for the same dish, seasoning differs from household to household.
cf: 十人十色 is specifically about people's tastes/personalities; 千差万別 covers any kind of variety.
cards.note: Sometimes read せんさまんべつ, but せんさばんべつ is standard.

cards.g: taking the initiative, leading by example
cards.d: 人より先に立って、自分から物事を行うこと。
s: 研究会を率先して開き、仲間と知恵を出し合う者もいれば、AIを相手に一人で新しい手を模索する者もいる。
率先
Some take the lead in organising study groups and pool ideas with friends; others search alone for new moves against AI.
部長が率先して片付けを始めたので、みんなも手伝った。
率先
The manager took it upon himself to start tidying up, so everyone pitched in.
cf: 優先 (ゆうせん) = priority; 率先 (そっせん) = going first yourself. Note the reading: not りっせん.
cards.note: Almost always used as 率先して + verb.

cards.g: to steer; to take the helm, be in charge
cards.d: 船の進む向きを決める。また、組織などを導いて動かす。
s: 朝霧はその両方を取り入れ、自分で研究の舵を取ってきた。
舵を取っ
Asagiri has combined both approaches, steering his own study.
来月からは、新しい社長が会社の舵を取る。
舵を取る
From next month, a new president will take the helm of the company.
cf: 舵を切る = to turn the wheel, i.e. change course/policy (方針転換); 舵を取る = to be the one steering.

cards.g: help, backing (of one side in a fight); reinforcements
cards.d: 争いなどで、一方の側に力を貸して助けること。
s: 同世代の棋士と競うように腕を磨き、伸び悩んだ時期には兄弟子たちが研究相手として加勢してくれたという。
加勢
He honed his skill as if racing his peers, and when he hit a plateau, senior disciples of his teacher stepped in to help as study partners.
けんかに友達が加勢して、騒ぎがさらに大きくなった。
加勢
A friend joined in on his side in the fight, and the commotion grew even bigger.
cf: 応援 = cheering/support in general; 加勢 = actually joining a side to add strength in a struggle.
加盟 = joining an organization as a member.

cards.g: hand-to-hand fighting, grappling; (fig.) wrestling with a problem
cards.d: 組み合って戦うこと。また、難しいことに必死に取り組むこと。
s: 格闘も将棋も、相手と向き合って争う点では同じだというのが剛志さんの考えだった。
格闘
Takeshi believed that fighting and shogi are the same in that you face an opponent and contend with them.
一晩中、難しい数学の問題と格闘した。
格闘
I wrestled with a hard maths problem all night.
cf: 闘争 = struggle/conflict (political, labour); 格闘 = physical grappling or wrestling with a task.
cards.note: The figurative 〜と格闘する (wrestle with paperwork, a problem) is very common.

cards.d: 柔道や空手、ボクシングなど、戦う競技を職業にする人。
s: 元格闘家で、今も屈強な体つきの剛志さんは、幼い湊が有り余る体力を持て余しているのを見て、自分の道場に連れて行った。
格闘家
Takeshi, a former martial artist who is still powerfully built, saw that little Minato had more energy than he knew what to do with, and took him to his own dojo.
引退した格闘家が、テレビで料理番組の司会をしている。
格闘家
A retired fighter is hosting a cooking show on TV.
cf: 武道家 = practitioner of traditional budō (judo, kendo, karate) with a spiritual flavour; 格闘家 = combat-sports fighter, often professional.

cards.d: 体が大きく力が強く、たくましいさま。
s: 元格闘家で、今も屈強な体つきの剛志さんは、幼い湊が有り余る体力を持て余しているのを見て、自分の道場に連れて行った。
屈強
Takeshi, a former martial artist who is still powerfully built, saw that little Minato had more energy than he knew what to do with, and took him to his own dojo.
屈強な男たちが、重いピアノを二階へ運び上げた。
屈強
Burly men carried the heavy piano up to the second floor.
cf: 頑強 = stubborn/tenacious (頑強に抵抗する) as well as sturdy; 屈強 is about physical brawn.
cards.note: Used of people and bodies; not of objects or arguments.

cards.d: 練習として、本番と同じように行うこと。大学の少人数の授業も指す。
s: 今も詰将棋の演習問題を毎日十問解くことは欠かさない。
演習
Even now, he never misses solving ten tsume-shogi practice problems a day.
沖合で、海上自衛隊の大規模な演習が行われた。
演習
The Maritime Self-Defense Force held large-scale exercises offshore.
大学三年からは、ゼミ形式の演習に参加する。
演習
From third year, students take part in seminar-style classes.
cf: 練習 = everyday practice (piano, sport); 演習 = structured exercises, drills, manoeuvres or academic seminar.
cards.note: Three distinct contexts: textbook exercises (演習問題), military/disaster drills, and university seminars.

cards.d: 手がかりが少ない中で、方法などをあれこれ探し求めること。
s: 研究会を率先して開き、仲間と知恵を出し合う者もいれば、AIを相手に一人で新しい手を模索する者もいる。
模索
Some take the lead in organising study groups and pool ideas with friends; others search alone for new moves against AI.
政府は、景気回復への道を模索している。
模索
The government is searching for a path to economic recovery.
cf: 探索 = exploring/searching a place or thing (宇宙探索); 模索 = feeling your way toward a solution or approach.
cards.note: Also written 摸索. Classic news phrase: 〜の道を模索する.

cards.d: 物事を行うときの、決まったやり方や技術。
s: 久世九段はあえて定跡を外す手法で若い挑戦者を揺さぶろうとしたが、朝霧の指し手に乱れはなかった。
手法
Kuze 9-dan deliberately left standard lines to rattle the young challenger, but Asagiri's moves never wavered.
この映画は、ドキュメンタリーの手法で撮られている。
手法
This film is shot using documentary techniques.
cf: 方法 = way/method in general; 手法 = a characteristic technique, especially in art, research or strategy.
手段 = means to an end; 手法 = the technique of how it's done.

title.ja: 脳と言葉の科学 — 習得・検証・身体
title.en: Brain and language science: acquisition, verification, the body

modules.passageTitle: 大人の脳は第二言語をどう覚えるか

cards.d: 心や言葉の働きが、体のあり方と深く結びついているという性質。
s: 近年注目されているのが、言語の身体性という考え方である。
身体性
One idea attracting attention recently is the embodiment of language.
AIに欠けているのは身体性だ、と指摘する研究者もいる。
身体性
Some researchers point out that what AI lacks is a body — embodiment.
cf: Homophone しんたいせい: 'new regime/structure' (新体制で臨む). Context always disambiguates.
cards.note: A term from philosophy and cognitive science (cf. 身体化された認知, 'embodied cognition'); rare in casual talk.

cards.d: 人が死んで体がなくなっても、たましいは消えずに残るという考え。
s: 古代ギリシャのプラトンは霊魂不滅を説き、仏教は万物の無常を説いた。
霊魂不滅
Plato in ancient Greece taught the immortality of the soul; Buddhism taught the impermanence of all things.
霊魂不滅の信仰は、多くの宗教に共通して見られる。
霊魂不滅
Belief in the immortality of the soul is found across many religions.
cf: Never aging and never dying — immortality of the body, not the soul.
cards.note: Philosophy/religion vocabulary. In everyday speech you'd say 魂は死なない or 死後も魂が残る.

cards.d: 物事を考えたり判断したりするときの立場。
s: 本稿では、脳科学と言語学の見地から、大人が第二言語を習得する仕組みを考えてみたい。
見地
In this essay I want to consider, from the standpoint of neuroscience and linguistics, how adults acquire a second language.
医学的見地から言えば、その食事法はおすすめできません。
見地
From a medical point of view, I can't recommend that diet.
cf: 観点 is the angle or aspect you look at something from; 見地 is the (often expert) standpoint you judge from. Often interchangeable in 〜から.
立場 is the everyday word for one's position or situation; 見地 is formal and intellectual.
cards.note: Almost always appears as 〜(的)見地から. Formal; sounds stiff in conversation.

cards.g: naturally, of itself, in due course
cards.d: わざわざ何かをしなくても、流れにまかせて自然にそうなる様子。
s: 意味のわかる文に毎日少しずつ触れていれば、文法の感覚は自ずと身についていく。
自ずと
If you're exposed every day to a little text you understand, a feel for grammar develops of its own accord.
毎日練習を続けていれば、結果は自ずとついてくるよ。
自ずと
Keep practicing every day and results will come naturally.
col: 答えは自ずと見えてくる
cf: 自然と is the everyday word; 自ずと is more literary and implies the result follows logically from the circumstances.
Same kanji, read みずから: 'oneself, personally' — the opposite idea (deliberate action).
cards.note: Also written 自ずから (おのずから), which is more formal still.

cards.d: 理屈に合わないのに、昔から人々に信じられている言い伝え。
s: しかし、その多くは丹念に確かめられたことのない、一種の迷信にすぎない。
迷信
But most of them have never been carefully checked; they are no more than a kind of superstition.
夜に爪を切ると親の死に目に会えないというのは、有名な迷信だ。
迷信
That cutting your nails at night means you won't be at your parents' deathbed is a well-known superstition.
cf: Folk belief — a neutral, academic term; 迷信 carries the judgment that the belief is irrational.

cards.d: 学んだり練習したりして、技術や知識を自分のものにすること。
s: 本稿では、脳科学と言語学の見地から、大人が第二言語を習得する仕組みを考えてみたい。
習得
In this essay I want to consider, from the standpoint of neuroscience and linguistics, how adults acquire a second language.
手話を習得するのに、彼女は三年かかった。
習得
It took her three years to learn sign language.
cf: Same reading; used for completing course units (単位を修得する). 習得 is mastering a skill.
Obtaining something formal — a license, qualification, data (免許を取得する), not learning a skill.
cards.note: 第二言語習得 (SLA) is the standard academic term.

cards.d: 学んで身につけたのではなく、生まれたときから持っている様子。
s: 言語能力がどこまで生得的なものかという問いは、長く議論されてきた。
生得的
The question of how far language ability is innate has long been debated.
赤ちゃんが人の顔に強く反応するのは、生得的な傾向だと考えられている。
生得的
Babies' strong response to human faces is thought to be an innate tendency.
cf: 先天的 is the general/medical word (congenital), paired with 後天的. 生得的 belongs to philosophy and cognitive science, contrasted with 'learned' (習得的, 経験的).
cards.note: The nativist position in linguistics is 生得説.

cards.d: 生まれる前から、体や性質に備わっている様子。
s: その反面、外国語の得手不得手が先天的に決まっているという証拠は乏しい。
先天的
On the other hand, there's little evidence that being good or bad at foreign languages is fixed from birth.
彼は先天的な心臓の病気を抱えながら、マラソンを完走した。
先天的
Despite a congenital heart condition, he finished the marathon.
cf: See 生得的: 先天的 is broader and medical; 生得的 is the cognitive-science term for innate vs. learned.
The antonym: acquired after birth (後天的な障害).
cards.note: In medical names the prefix 先天性〜 is standard (先天性心疾患). The 'a priori' sense is old philosophy translationese; today ア・プリオリ is more common.

cards.d: 今までずっとそうであったこと。これまでのもの。
s: 多読や音読といった従来の学習法の効果も、ようやく数字で検証されるようになったのである。
従来
Even the effects of conventional methods such as extensive reading and reading aloud have finally come to be verified with numbers.
新しい電池は、従来より二倍長く使えるそうだ。
従来
Apparently the new battery lasts twice as long as before.
cf: Native/long-established in a place (在来種, 在来線); not 'the method up to now'.
Old, from long ago — often with a negative 'outdated' tinge (旧来の慣習).
cards.note: Very common in news and product copy: 従来品 'the previous model'.

cards.d: 細かいところまで手をぬかず、時間をかけてていねいにする様子。
s: しかし、その多くは丹念に確かめられたことのない、一種の迷信にすぎない。
丹念
But most of them have never been carefully checked; they are no more than a kind of superstition.
祖父は古い時計を一つ一つ丹念に磨いていた。
丹念
My grandfather was carefully polishing the old clocks one by one.
cf: Thorough, especially careful preparation or checking (入念な準備); 丹念 stresses patient, detailed labor.
The everyday word for careful/polite; 丹念 is more literary and implies time spent.

cards.d: 数や量で表して、比べたり調べたりする様子。
s: 近年は、こうした問いを定量的に扱う研究が増えてきた。
定量的
Recently there has been more research treating such questions quantitatively.
効果を定量的に示さなければ、予算はつかないだろう。
定量的
Unless you can show the effect quantitatively, you won't get funding.
cf: The antonym: qualitative (定性的な調査).

cards.d: 途中で切れたり、また続いたりをくり返す様子。
s: それによると、仕事の都合で断続的にしか学べなかった人でも、触れた言葉の総量が多ければ成績は着実に伸びていた。
断続的
According to it, even people who could only study on and off because of work improved steadily if their total exposure was large.
明日は昼過ぎまで断続的に雨が降るでしょう。
断続的
Tomorrow, rain will fall on and off until early afternoon.
cf: Continuous, sustained without breaks — the opposite idea.
Unbroken, in a continuous series; 断続的 means with gaps.
cards.note: A weather-forecast staple: 断続的に強い雨.

cards.d: 目や知能に問題がないのに、文字を読むことがとても難しい状態。
s: 失読症のある人の脳では、この結びつきを担う左半球の領域の働きが弱い傾向が報告されている。
失読症
In people with dyslexia, the left-hemisphere regions responsible for this link have been reported to tend to be less active.
息子は失読症と診断されたが、読み上げ機能を使って勉強を続けている。
失読症
My son was diagnosed with dyslexia, but he keeps studying using text-to-speech.
cf: 難読 describes a word that is hard to read (難読漢字); 失読症 is a condition of the reader.
The loanword now more common for developmental dyslexia, along with 発達性読み書き障害.
cards.note: Strictly, 失読症 can also mean acquired alexia (loss of reading after brain injury); for the developmental condition ディスレクシア is more usual today.

cards.d: 漢字などの読み方がむずかしく、正しく読める人が少ないこと。
s: 漢字の読みが一つに決まらないため、難読の地名や人名は母語の話者にとっても手ごわい。
難読
Because kanji readings aren't fixed to one, hard-to-read place names and personal names are tough even for native speakers.
テレビで難読漢字クイズを見るのが、父の楽しみだ。
難読
Watching tricky-kanji quizzes on TV is my father's pleasure.
cf: A reading disorder of a person — not a property of a word.
cards.note: Used almost only as a prefix or with の (難読の名字). Japanese TV loves 難読地名 quizzes.

cards.d: 話をする人。また、ある言葉を使って話す人。
s: 漢字の読みが一つに決まらないため、難読の地名や人名は母語の話者にとっても手ごわい。
話者
Because kanji readings aren't fixed to one, hard-to-read place names and personal names are tough even for native speakers.
この方言の話者は、いまでは数百人ほどしか残っていない。
話者
Only a few hundred speakers of this dialect remain today.
cf: The everyday word for the person speaking; 話者 is linguistic or formal.
Narrator of a story; 話者 for 'narrator' is mostly literary-criticism usage.
cards.note: 母語話者 is the standard term for 'native speaker' in writing; ネイティブ is the casual equivalent.

cards.g: visual system (eyes + visual pathways of the brain)
cards.d: 目から入った光の情報を受け取り、脳で処理するしくみ全体。
s: 文字を読むとき、脳ではまず視覚系が形をとらえ、それが音や意味と結びつけられる。
視覚系
When we read, the brain's visual system first captures the shapes, which are then linked to sounds and meanings.
猫の視覚系は、暗い場所で動く物をとらえるのに適している。
視覚系
A cat's visual system is suited to catching moving things in the dark.
cf: The sense of sight itself; 視覚系 is the whole anatomical/neural system behind it.
cards.note: Source gloss 'ophthalmencephalon' is an obscure anatomical term; 'visual system' is the sense you'll meet.

cards.d: 強い磁場の中の原子核が、決まった電波を吸ったり出したりする現象。
s: 磁気共鳴断層撮影、いわゆるMRIは、強い磁場の中で起こる磁気共鳴という現象を利用して体の内部を画像にする。
磁気共鳴
Magnetic resonance imaging, or MRI, uses a phenomenon called magnetic resonance that occurs in a strong magnetic field to image the inside of the body.
核磁気共鳴は、化学の分野でも物質の構造を調べるのに使われる。
磁気共鳴
Nuclear magnetic resonance is also used in chemistry to study the structure of substances.
cf: On its own: resonance, and figuratively 'sympathy with' an idea (考えに共鳴する).

cards.r: じききょうめいだんそうさつえい
cards.d: 強い磁石と電波を使って、体の断面を画像にする検査。
s: 磁気共鳴断層撮影、いわゆるMRIは、強い磁場の中で起こる磁気共鳴という現象を利用して体の内部を画像にする。
磁気共鳴断層撮影
Magnetic resonance imaging, or MRI, uses a phenomenon called magnetic resonance that occurs in a strong magnetic field to image the inside of the body.
磁気共鳴断層撮影は、放射線を使わない検査として広く普及している。
磁気共鳴断層撮影
MRI is widely used as an examination that involves no radiation.
col: 磁気共鳴断層撮影装置
磁気共鳴断層撮影で調べる
cf: コンピュータ断層撮影
CT: cross-sectional imaging using X-rays, not magnetism.
cards.note: The full term is formal/written; patients and doctors just say MRI (エムアールアイ). Also 磁気共鳴画像法.

cards.d: 耳の奥にあり、音を受けて震えるうすい膜。
s: 音はまず鼓膜を震わせ、私たちは口や舌を動かして初めて声を出す。
鼓膜
Sound first vibrates the eardrum, and we produce voice only by moving the mouth and tongue.
鼓膜が破れるかと思うほど、大きな音だった。
鼓膜
The noise was so loud I thought my eardrums would burst.
cards.note: 鼓 is 'drum' (太鼓), so the compound is transparent: 'drum membrane'.

cards.d: 病気やけがを治すこと。また、そのための仕事やしくみ。
s: もともと医療の現場で患者を診るために発達した技術が、いまでは言語研究に欠かせない道具になった。
医療
A technology originally developed to examine patients in medical settings has become an indispensable tool in language research.
地方では、十分な医療を受けられる病院が減っている。
医療
In rural areas, hospitals that can provide adequate medical care are decreasing.
cf: Treatment of a specific illness or injury; 医療 is medical care as a whole/system.
Medicine as a science or academic field.

cards.d: 医者が患者の体の具合を調べる。
s: もともと医療の現場で患者を診るために発達した技術が、いまでは言語研究に欠かせない道具になった。
診る
A technology originally developed to examine patients in medical settings has become an indispensable tool in language research.
熱が下がらないなら、一度お医者さんに診てもらったほうがいいよ。
診て
If your fever won't go down, you'd better get a doctor to look at you.
cf: General 'see/look'. Also acceptable in kana or 見る for casual writing.
To look after, nurse (看病, 親を看る) — care, not diagnosis.
cards.note: Mostly heard as 診てもらう 'get examined'. Doctors may say 患者さんを診る.

cards.d: 話や計画などが、はっきりした形や中身を持っていること。
s: 抽象的な説明より具体性のある例文が記憶に残るのも、同じ理屈だろう。
具体性
The same logic probably explains why concrete example sentences stick in memory better than abstract explanations.
その提案は具体性に欠けると、会議で厳しく言われた。
具体性
At the meeting I was told bluntly that the proposal lacked specifics.
cf: The na-adjective; 具体性 is the noun 'the quality of being concrete'.
Feasibility proper. 具体性 only implies it — a plan 具体性に欠ける is vague, hence perhaps unrealistic.
cards.note: Source gloss 'feasibility' is misleading; the core meaning is concreteness/specificity. Very common as 具体性に欠ける.

cards.d: 形や中身がはっきりしていて、目に見えるようにわかる様子。
s: 単語を訳語と一対一で覚えるより、具体的な場面や体の動きとともに覚えたほうが定着しやすいのは、そのためだと考えられる。
具体的
That is thought to be why words stick better when learned with concrete situations and bodily movements than one-to-one with translations.
「もう少し具体的に説明してもらえますか」と上司に言われた。
具体的
My boss said, 'Could you explain a bit more specifically?'

cards.g: on the other hand; the other side
cards.d: ある面とは逆の、もう一方の面。
s: その反面、外国語の得手不得手が先天的に決まっているという証拠は乏しい。
反面
On the other hand, there's little evidence that being good or bad at foreign languages is fixed from birth.
この仕事は給料がいい反面、休みがほとんど取れない。
反面
This job pays well, but on the other hand you get almost no time off.
cf: Same reading: 'half (the face/surface)'; in the 'one side' sense the two are often used interchangeably.
More neutral 'meanwhile/on the other hand'; 反面 stresses a contrasting downside or opposite aspect.
cards.note: Pattern: [plain form] + 反面 'while X, (conversely) Y'. 反面教師 = a negative example to learn from.

cards.d: 本当かどうかは別にして、そうだとしてみると。また、一時的に。
s: 仮に才能というものがあるとしても、それは十分な量の入力と練習を重ねた後で、初めて見えてくるものだろう。
仮に
Even supposing there is such a thing as talent, it probably only becomes visible after plenty of input and practice.
仮に雨が降っても、試合は予定どおり行われます。
仮に
Even if it rains, the match will go ahead as planned.
正式な名前が決まるまで、仮にAチームと呼んでおこう。
仮に
Until we settle on an official name, let's call it Team A for now.
cf: Plain 'if'. 仮に emphasizes a hypothetical for argument's sake and pairs with としても/とすれば.
'In the unlikely event' — stresses improbability, often of something bad.

cards.g: distribution (spread over an area or range)
cards.d: ある範囲の中で、物がどこにどれだけあるかという広がり方。
s: ある調査では、大人の学習者数百人について、試験の成績の分布と学習時間との関係を分析している。
分布
One survey analyzed, for several hundred adult learners, the relation between the distribution of test scores and study time.
この植物は、本州の山地に広く分布している。
分布
This plant is widely distributed in the mountains of Honshu.
cf: Allocation — deliberately dividing something up (予算の配分). 分布 is how things happen to be spread out.
cards.note: Source gloss 'allocation' is misleading; that's 配分. 分布 is spatial or statistical distribution.

cards.d: この世のものはすべて移り変わり、同じままではいられないこと。
s: 古代ギリシャのプラトンは霊魂不滅を説き、仏教は万物の無常を説いた。
無常
Plato in ancient Greece taught the immortality of the soul; Buddhism taught the impermanence of all things.
散っていく桜を見ると、人生の無常を感じる。
無常
Watching the cherry blossoms fall, I feel the transience of life.
cf: Same reading むじょう: heartless, cruel (無情な雨).
cards.note: The opening of 平家物語: 祇園精舎の鐘の声、諸行無常の響きあり.

cards.d: 全体の中の、ある決まった部分や場所。
s: 音読をしてもらうと、語の落脱や読み誤りが特定の箇所に集中することも多い。
箇所
When they read aloud, omitted words and misreadings often cluster in particular spots.
この道路では、三箇所で工事が行われている。
箇所
Construction is going on at three places along this road.
cf: Common ways to write the counter: 3ヶ所, 3か所.

cards.g: omission, missing part (of a text); dropping out
cards.d: 文章などから、文字や言葉がぬけ落ちてしまうこと。
s: 音読をしてもらうと、語の落脱や読み誤りが特定の箇所に集中することも多い。
落脱
When they read aloud, omitted words and misreadings often cluster in particular spots.
この写本には数行の落脱があり、前後の意味がつながらない。
落脱
This manuscript is missing several lines, so the surrounding text doesn't connect.
cf: The common word: dropping out (レースから脱落する) or something falling off/omitted. Use 脱落 by default.
A missing character in writing (誤字脱字).
cards.note: Rare and bookish — mostly seen for omissions in texts and manuscripts. For 'dropping out / falling behind' natives say 脱落.

cards.g: return (of profits) to; reduction (to simpler terms); chemical reduction
cards.d: もとの形に戻すこと。また、得た利益を人々に返すこと。
s: 人の心をすべて脳の働きに還元できるのかという問いに、科学はまだ答えを出していない。
還元
Science has not yet answered whether the mind can be wholly reduced to the workings of the brain.
会社は利益の一部を地域社会に還元している。
還元
The company returns part of its profits to the local community.
鉄鉱石を還元して、鉄を取り出す。
還元
Iron is extracted by reducing iron ore.
cf: Homophone かんげん: rephrasing (換言すれば 'in other words').
Oxidation — the chemical opposite of 還元.
cards.note: Everyday you'll meet it in shopping (ポイント還元 'points back'); in philosophy, 還元主義 is reductionism.

title.ja: 計算機と形式言語 — 理系の語彙
title.en: Computers and formal languages: STEM vocabulary

modules.passageTitle: 記号で世界を書く ― 引力から文法まで

cards.d: 質量をもつすべての物どうしが、互いに引き合う力。
s: ニュートンが万有引力の法則を示したとき、人類は地上と天上の運動を同じ式で書き表す方法を手に入れた。
万有引力
When Newton set out the law of universal gravitation, humanity gained a way to describe earthly and celestial motion with the same equations.
万有引力があるなら、私と机も引き合っているの？
万有引力
If there's universal gravitation, does that mean my desk and I are pulling on each other?
cf: 重力 is gravity as felt on Earth (gravitation plus the centrifugal effect of rotation); 万有引力 is the attraction between any two masses.
cards.note: School physics term; everyday speech just says 重力 or 引力.

cards.g: axis of rotation (of a planet or spinning body)
cards.d: 天体などがその場で回るときの、回転の中心となる線。
s: 地球は自転軸を中心に、およそ一日で一回転している。
自転軸
The Earth makes one rotation about its axis roughly every day.
地球の自転軸が傾いているから、日本には四季がある。
自転軸
Japan has four seasons because the Earth's axis of rotation is tilted.
cf: 地軸 is specifically the Earth's axis; 自転軸 is the general term for any body's spin axis.
公転 is orbiting around something else; 自転 is spinning in place.
cards.note: Source gloss 'rotating shaft, axle' is misleading: a mechanical shaft is 回転軸 or シャフト. 自転軸 is the astronomy/physics 'axis of rotation'.

cards.d: 回っている物が、回転の中心から外へ押し出されるように感じる力。
s: そのため赤道に近いほど、外向きの遠心力が大きくはたらく。
遠心力
Because of this, the outward centrifugal force is larger the closer you are to the equator.
洗濯機は脱水のとき、遠心力で水を飛ばしている。
遠心力
During the spin cycle, a washing machine uses centrifugal force to throw off the water.
cf: Antonym in physics (centripetal force); figuratively 求心力 = a leader's pull/cohesion, 遠心力 = centrifugal, fragmenting tendencies.
cards.note: Also used figuratively in politics: 党内の遠心力が強まる = the party is pulling apart.

cards.g: freely, at will; with complete mastery
cards.d: 思いのままに、どのようにでも扱えるようす。
s: 規則が厳密だからこそ、プログラマーは部品を自由自在に組み合わせ、巨大なシステムを組み上げられるのだ。
自由自在
It is precisely because the rules are strict that programmers can combine parts at will and build huge systems.
あの子は五か国語を自由自在に操る。
自由自在
That kid switches between five languages with complete ease.
cf: 自在 alone (伸縮自在, 自在に) is the shorter, more written form; 自由自在 is emphatic.
cards.note: Most often as an adverb: 自由自在に + verb (操る, 使いこなす).

cards.d: 簡単な関数から決まった操作をくり返して作られる、計算できる関数。
s: その答えの一つが帰納的関数である。
帰納的関数
One answer to that was the recursive functions.
計算理論の授業で、帰納的関数とチューリング機械の関係を習った。
帰納的関数
In my theory of computation class, we learned how recursive functions relate to Turing machines.
cf: 再帰関数 is the programmer's word for a function that calls itself; 帰納的関数 is the logic/computability term for the class of computable functions.
cards.note: Translation of 'recursive function' in mathematical logic; programmers say 再帰関数 instead.

cards.d: 個々の例や前の段階から、一般的な結論や次の段階を導くようす。
s: 前の段階の結果を使って次の段階を定めるこのやり方を、数学では帰納的な定義と呼ぶ。
帰納的
In mathematics, this method of fixing each step using the result of the previous one is called an inductive (recursive) definition.
多くの実例から帰納的に結論を導くのが、この研究の手法だ。
帰納的
The method of this study is to draw conclusions inductively from many real examples.
cf: Same reading きのうてき. 機能的 = functional/practical; 帰納的 = inductive/recursive.
Opposite reasoning style: 演繹的 (えんえきてき) = deductive.
cards.note: Everyday-academic sense is 'inductive' (帰納法 = induction); in logic and computability it translates 'recursive' (帰納的集合 = recursive set).

cards.d: むだがなく、使う目的によく合っているようす。
s: 機能的なキッチン、機能的な服装といった具合だ。
機能的
Think of a functional kitchen, or practical clothing.
このリュックはポケットが多くて機能的だ。
機能的
This backpack has lots of pockets and is really practical.
cf: Same reading きのうてき. 帰納的 = inductive/recursive (logic).
'Functional programming' is 関数型プログラミング, not 機能的.
cards.note: Common in design, architecture and product reviews.

cards.r: けっていてきぶんみゃくじゆうぶんぽう
cards.d: 後戻りせずに先頭から一通りに構文を解析できる、文脈自由文法の一種。
s: 多くの言語は、文法の骨格を決定的文脈自由文法で記述できるように設計されている。
決定的文脈自由文法
Many languages are designed so that the backbone of their grammar can be described by a deterministic context-free grammar.
決定的文脈自由文法は、決定性プッシュダウンオートマトンで受理できる。
決定的文脈自由文法
A deterministic context-free grammar can be recognized by a deterministic pushdown automaton.
cf: The general class; the 'deterministic' subset can be parsed without backtracking and is never ambiguous.
cards.note: Formal-language theory term; compiler texts often say LR文法 for the practical equivalent. Parse as 決定的 + 文脈自由 + 文法.

cards.d: ある意味や内容を表すために使う、しるしや文字。
s: 物理学とは、ある意味で、複雑な現象を少数の記号に圧縮する営みなのだ。
記号
Physics is, in a sense, the work of compressing complex phenomena into a handful of symbols.
パスワードには、英字と数字に加えて記号も入れてください。
記号
Please include symbols in your password as well as letters and numbers.
cf: 符号 = code/sign in a technical sense (プラスの符号 = plus sign, 符号化 = encoding).
標識 = a physical sign/marker, e.g. 道路標識.
cards.note: In passwords and keyboards, 記号 means punctuation-type characters like #, @, !.

cards.d: 本の中の語句がどのページにあるかを、探しやすく並べた一覧。
s: そこで鍵を握るのが、索引と呼ばれる仕組みである。
索引
What holds the key is a mechanism called an index.
知らない用語は、巻末の索引で探してみてね。
索引
If there's a term you don't know, try looking it up in the index at the back.
cf: 目次 = table of contents (front, by chapter); 索引 = index (back, by term).
Katakana インデックス is used in IT and finance (index funds); 索引 is the book/technical word.
cards.note: In databases both 索引 and インデックス are used.

cards.g: binding particle (abbreviation of 係助詞 かかりじょし)
cards.d: 辞書の品詞表示で使う、「は」「も」「こそ」などの助詞の種類の略称。
s: 国語辞典で「は」を引くと、品詞の欄に〔係助〕と記されていることが多い。
係助
If you look up は in a Japanese dictionary, its part of speech is often marked [係助].
古語辞典では、「ぞ」「なむ」「こそ」も〔係助〕に分類されている。
係助
In classical-Japanese dictionaries, ぞ, なむ and こそ are also classed as [係助] (binding particles).
cf: 格助詞 (が, を, に...) mark grammatical case; 係助詞 (は, も, こそ...) add topic or emphasis and, in classical Japanese, govern the sentence-final form (係り結び).
副助詞 (だけ, ばかり, さえ...) — some grammars overlap with 係助詞; classification varies.
cards.note: 係助 is the part-of-speech label printed in dictionaries, short for 係助詞 (かかりじょし). When speaking, people say the full word 係助詞; treat 係助 as something you read, not say.

title.ja: 台所と旅の宿 — 食・暮らし・季節
title.en: Kitchen and inn: food, daily life, seasons

cards.d: カツオの身を煮て干し、固くしたもの。削ってだしなどに使う。
s: ご主人は注文が入るたびにかつお節を削り、その香りが狭い店内に広がっていた。
かつお節
Each time an order came in, the owner shaved katsuobushi, and its aroma filled the cramped shop.
冷ややっこにかつお節をのせて、しょうゆを少したらす。
かつお節
Top the chilled tofu with bonito flakes and drizzle on a little soy sauce.
col: かつお節でだしを取る
cf: 削り節 is shaved flakes (from bonito or other fish); かつお節 is both the hard block and its flakes.
cards.note: Kanji spelling 鰹節. Packaged flakes are often sold as 花かつお or 削り節.

cards.d: 料理で、包丁を使って食材を切るときに下に置く板。
s: まな板の上でねぎを刻む音も小気味よく、待つ時間さえごちそうに思えた。
まな板
The crisp sound of green onions being chopped on the cutting board made even the wait feel like a treat.
手術を待つ間は、まさにまな板の鯉の心境だった。
まな板
Waiting for the operation, I felt exactly like a carp on the cutting board — completely at others' mercy.
cards.note: まな板の鯉 (a carp on the cutting board) is a common idiom for being helpless, with your fate in someone else's hands.

cards.g: Sanuki udon (firm, chewy udon from Kagawa)
cards.d: 香川県の名物で、こしが強いのが特徴のうどん。
s: 目当てはもちろん讃岐うどんで、三日間で何軒回れるかがひそかな課題だった。
讃岐うどん
Sanuki udon was of course the goal, and my private challenge was how many shops I could hit in three days.
駅前の讃岐うどんの店は、朝七時から行列ができている。
讃岐うどん
The Sanuki udon place in front of the station has a line from seven in the morning.
col: 讃岐うどんを食べ歩く
cards.note: 讃岐 is the old province name for present-day Kagawa, which markets itself as うどん県. こし (firm, springy bite) is the key word for praising it.

cards.d: 中国の四川で作られる漬物。からし菜の太い茎を塩と香辛料で漬ける。
s: 昆布や煮干しなどの乾物と漬物を扱う店で、棚の隅には本場のザーサイまで並んでいる。
ザーサイ
It's a shop for dried goods like kelp and dried sardines plus pickles, and in the corner of the shelf there's even authentic zha cai.
おかゆにザーサイを少し添えると、ぐっと食が進む。
ザーサイ
Add a little zha cai to rice porridge and you'll find yourself eating much more.
cards.note: From Chinese 榨菜. Common in Japan as a side for rice porridge, ramen or fried rice; usually sold sliced in packets or jars.

cards.g: staying overnight without meals; room-only stay
cards.d: 宿で食事をつけず、部屋に泊まるだけにすること。
s: 宿は町はずれの古い旅館で、食事はうどん屋で済ませるつもりで素泊りにした。
素泊り
The inn was an old ryokan on the edge of town; I planned to eat at udon shops, so I booked a room-only stay.
素泊りなら、一泊四千円で泊まれますよ。
素泊り
If you go room-only, you can stay for 4,000 yen a night.
cf: 一泊二食(付き) is the standard ryokan package with dinner and breakfast — the opposite of 素泊り.
cards.note: Usually spelled 素泊まり; 素泊り is a common shortened okurigana variant seen on signs and booking sites.

cards.g: tokonoma (raised alcove for a scroll or flowers)
cards.d: 和室の奥を一段高くし、掛け軸や花を飾るところ。
s: 通された六畳間には小さな床の間があり、柿を描いた掛け軸が下がっている。
床の間
The six-mat room I was shown to had a small tokonoma, with a hanging scroll of persimmons.
祖父は床の間に、季節ごとの花を生けていた。
床の間
My grandfather used to arrange seasonal flowers in the tokonoma.
col: 床の間を背にして座る
cards.note: The seat with one's back to the tokonoma is the place of honor (上座), offered to guests.

cards.d: 商品につけて、いくらかを示す小さな札。
s: 値札はすべて彼女の手書きで、高校の頃と同じ丸い字だった。
値札
Every price tag was handwritten by her, in the same round letters as in high school.
プレゼントだから、値札は外しておいてね。
値札
It's a present, so take the price tag off, okay?
cf: 値段 is the price itself; 値札 is the physical tag showing it.

cards.g: opening a business; starting a practice; opening (of a line/station)
cards.d: 新しく商売や事業を始めること。
s: 十月の終わり、高校時代からの友人の美咲が高松で店を開業したと聞き、香川へ向かった。
開業
In late October, hearing that my high-school friend Misaki had opened a shop in Takamatsu, I headed for Kagawa.
新しい駅は、来年の春に開業する予定だ。
開業
The new station is scheduled to open next spring.
cf: 開店 is opening a shop (also opening for the day); 開業 is starting a business or practice as a whole.
創業 is founding a company, used for history: 創業100年.
創開 is a very rare word; normal Japanese uses 開業 or 開店.
cards.note: Also used for railways and facilities: 新幹線の開業. 開業医 is a doctor in private practice.

cards.d: 新しく始めること。店などを開くこと。ふつうは使わない珍しい語。
s: 入り口のチラシには「創開記念セール」とある。
創開
The flyer at the entrance says “Grand Opening Sale.”
「創開」は辞書にもほとんど載っていない、珍しい言葉だ。
創開
“Sōkai” (創開) is an unusual word that hardly appears even in dictionaries.
cf: 開業/開店 are what people actually say for opening a business.
Homophone そうかい: refreshing, exhilarating (気分爽快).
Homophone そうかい: general meeting (株主総会).
cards.note: Very rare: most natives would not recognize it, and it is easily heard as 爽快 or 総会. Learn to read it, but use 開業・開店・創業 yourself. Source gloss “grand opening” overstates how established it is.

cards.d: 手紙や荷物、メールなどを届ける相手や、その住所。
s: 宛先が前の住所のままの封筒が、何通も交じっている。
宛先
Mixed in were several envelopes still addressed to my old address.
メールの宛先を間違えて、別の人に送ってしまった。
宛先
I got the email recipient wrong and sent it to someone else.
cf: 宛名 is the addressee's name; 宛先 is the destination/address (or recipient field in email).
cards.note: Also written あて先. In email software, 宛先 is the “To:” field.

cards.d: 郵便物などを届けてもらう住所を、新しいものに変えること。
s: 春に引っ越したのに、通販サイトや会報のあて先変更をいくつか忘れていたらしい。
あて先変更
I moved in spring, yet it seems I forgot to update my address with a few online shops and newsletters.
引っ越したので、カード会社にあて先変更を届け出た。
あて先変更
Since I moved, I notified the card company of my change of address.
cf: 転送 is forwarding mail to a new address (Japan Post does this after a 転居届); あて先変更 is updating the address itself.
住所変更 is the general term for changing one's registered address; あて先変更 focuses on where items are sent.
cards.note: Source gloss “redirection” is misleading: in everyday use it means updating the delivery address with a sender. Also written 宛先変更.

cards.d: お金や品物を、学校や団体などに見返りなしで差し出すこと。
s: 売り上げの一部は、台風で傷んだ近くの神社の修繕に寄付するそうだ。
寄付
She says part of the proceeds will be donated to repair a nearby shrine damaged in the typhoon.
卒業生からの寄付で、図書館に新しい本棚が入った。
寄付
Thanks to donations from alumni, the library got new bookshelves.
cf: 募金 is collecting money (often small sums, street collections); 寄付 is the act of giving.
寄附 is the same word in official/legal spelling.

cards.d: 体に少しひんやりとした寒さを感じるようす。
s: 宿に戻るころには、日が落ちてすっかり肌寒くなっていた。
肌寒く
By the time I got back to the inn, the sun had set and it had turned quite chilly.
朝晩は肌寒いから、上着を一枚持っていくといいよ。
肌寒い
Mornings and evenings are chilly, so you should bring a jacket.
cf: 寒い is plainly cold; 肌寒い is a mild chill felt on the skin, typical of autumn or early spring.
cards.note: Source gloss “unpleasantly cold” overstates it: 肌寒い is a light, seasonal chill, a staple of autumn weather talk.

cards.d: 集まりなどに人が多く、にぎやかで立派なようす。
s: その晩の開店祝いは盛大で、商店街の人たちが入れ替わり立ち替わり顔を出した。
盛大
The opening party that evening was a big affair, with people from the shopping street dropping in one after another.
彼は段差につまずいて、みんなの前で盛大に転んだ。
盛大に
He tripped on a step and took a spectacular fall in front of everyone.
cards.note: Standard use is for celebrations and applause. In casual speech 盛大に〜 jokingly means “in a big way”: 盛大に転ぶ, 盛大にこぼす.

cards.d: 運がよいこと。よいめぐり合わせ。
s: 「でも、そのおかげで今の物件に出会えたんだから幸運だった」と彼女は言う。
幸運
“But because of that I found this place, so it was a stroke of luck,” she says.
試験の前日、友人から「幸運を祈る」とメッセージが届いた。
幸運
The day before the exam, a friend messaged me: “Good luck.”
cf: 幸福 is happiness or well-being; 幸運 is luck.
好運 is an alternative spelling of the same word.

cards.g: welling up, gushing out (of springs, oil)
cards.d: 地中から水や湯、油などがわき出ること。
s: この旅館の自慢は、敷地内から湧出する温泉だ。
湧出
This inn's pride is the hot spring that wells up on its own grounds.
この源泉の湧出量は、毎分五百リットルに達する。
湧出
The flow rate of this hot spring source reaches 500 liters per minute.
cf: 湧き出る is the everyday verb; 湧出 is the technical/written word used on hot spring signs and in reports.
cards.note: Very common on onsen information boards (湧出量, 湧出地). In speech people say 湧き出る or 出る.

cards.d: 本の読みかけの所にはさむ目印。また、行事などの案内の小冊子。
s: 出発前に届いた彼女のはがきには、手書きの地図とおすすめの店が並び、ちょっとした旅のしおりのようだった。
しおり
Her postcard, which arrived before I left, had a hand-drawn map and recommended shops — like a little travel guidebook.
読みかけのページにしおりをはさんで、電気を消した。
しおり
I slipped a bookmark into the page I was on and turned off the light.
cf: 栞 is the kanji spelling of the same word; the guidebook sense (旅のしおり) is usually in hiragana.
cards.note: 旅のしおり / 修学旅行のしおり is the booklet of schedule and rules every Japanese student gets before a school trip.

cards.d: 読みかけの本にはさんで、どこまで読んだかの目印にするもの。
s: 片づけを終えて旅の手帳を開くと、紅葉を押した栞がはさまっていた。
栞
When I finished tidying and opened my travel notebook, I found a bookmark with a pressed maple leaf tucked inside.
祖母の本には、四つ葉のクローバーを押した栞が残っていた。
栞
In my grandmother's book was a bookmark made from a pressed four-leaf clover.
cf: Same word. 栞 looks literary and suits the bookmark object; hiragana しおり is more common, especially for guide booklets.
cards.note: The on'yomi カン in the source is almost never used. 栞 is also a popular girl's name (Shiori).

cards.d: 品物や内容をよく調べて、よいものを選ぶこと。
s: 「仕入れ先を一軒ずつ吟味していたら、こうなったの」と彼女は笑った。
吟味
“I went through my suppliers one by one, choosing carefully, and this is how it ended up,” she laughed.
彼は言葉を一つひとつ吟味しながら、お礼の手紙を書いた。
吟味
He wrote the thank-you letter weighing every single word.
cf: 検討 is considering options before deciding; 吟味 stresses scrutinizing quality and picking the best.
cards.note: Very common in food writing: 吟味された素材 “carefully selected ingredients.” Historical senses (Edo-period interrogation, savoring poetry) are rare today.

cards.d: 物を種類や行き先ごとに分けること。
s: 東京に戻ると、留守中にたまった郵便物の仕分けが待っていた。
仕分け
Back in Tokyo, I had to sort the mail that had piled up while I was away.
年末の物流センターでは、荷物の仕分けが夜通し続く。
仕分け
At year's end, sorting parcels at the distribution center goes on all night.
cf: 仕訳 (same reading) is the bookkeeping term: journal entry.
分類 is classification in an abstract or scholarly sense; 仕分け is hands-on sorting.
cards.note: 事業仕分け was the 2009–10 public review of government spending programs. The bookkeeping sense in the source is normally written 仕訳.

cards.d: 化粧や服でおおわれていない、そのままの肌。
s: 冷えきった素肌に湯がじんわりとしみて、思わず長いため息が出た。
素肌
The hot water slowly soaked into my chilled bare skin, and I let out a long sigh without meaning to.
素肌に直接着ても、ちくちくしないセーターだ。
素肌
It's a sweater that doesn't itch even worn directly against bare skin.
cf: 素顔 is a face without makeup (also one's true self); 素肌 is bare skin in general.
cards.note: Frequent in cosmetics and clothing ads (素肌感, 素肌にやさしい).

cards.d: 水などが透き通らなくなる。また、音に濁点がつく。
s: 湯はわずかに白く濁っていて、ほのかに硫黄のにおいがする。
濁って
The water is slightly milky and gives off a faint smell of sulfur.
「本」は「三本」になると、濁って「ぼん」と読む。
濁って
本 becomes voiced when it's 三本, and is read “bon.”
雨のあとで、川の水が茶色く濁っている。
濁って
After the rain, the river water has turned muddy brown.
cf: 濁す is transitive: 言葉を濁す “to be evasive.” 濁る is intransitive.
cards.note: Also figurative: 目が濁る, 心が濁る (lose purity). 濁り湯 is the term for cloudy hot spring water.

cards.d: 焼けるように熱いこと。また、気持ちが激しく燃え上がること。
s: 灼熱の夏の教室で、下敷きをうちわ代わりにあおぎながら、いつか店を持ちたいと語っていたのが彼女だった。
灼熱
In our scorching summer classroom, fanning herself with a plastic desk pad, she was the one who talked about someday having her own shop.
灼熱の恋に身を焦がす主人公を描いた小説だ。
灼熱
It's a novel about a heroine consumed by a burning love.
cf: 酷暑 is severe summer heat (weather term); 灼熱 is more vivid and literary, and can be figurative.
cards.note: Usually used as 灼熱の〜. Common in weather reports and sports headlines for brutal heat.

cards.g: be exhilarated, feel buoyant; stand out
cards.d: 楽しいことを思って、心がうきうきする。
s: 読んでいるだけで、もう気持ちが浮き立った。
浮き立った
Just reading it, I was already in high spirits.
春の日差しを浴びて、街全体が浮き立っているように見えた。
浮き立って
Bathed in spring sunlight, the whole town seemed buoyant.
cf: 浮かれる is getting carried away, often with a hint of criticism; 浮き立つ is a pleasant lift of mood.
cards.note: Can also mean “stand out” visually (白い花が浮き立って見える).

cards.d: 字を急いで乱暴に書くこと。また、そうして書いたもの。
s: 私は麺のこしや出汁の味を手帳に殴り書きし、勝手に十点満点で採点していった。
殴り書き
I scrawled notes in my notebook on the noodles' chewiness and the broth, grading each shop out of ten on my own.
電話を受けながら、メモ用紙に番号を殴り書きした。
殴り書き
While on the phone, I scribbled the number on a memo pad.
cf: 走り書き is quick hasty writing; 殴り書き stresses messiness, almost illegible.

cards.g: desk pad (sheet under writing paper); basis, model
cards.d: 字を書くとき紙の下に敷く板。また、物事のもとになるもの。
s: 灼熱の夏の教室で、下敷きをうちわ代わりにあおぎながら、いつか店を持ちたいと語っていたのが彼女だった。
下敷き
In our scorching summer classroom, fanning herself with a plastic desk pad, she was the one who talked about someday having her own shop.
この映画は、古い民話を下敷きにしている。
下敷き
This film is based on an old folk tale.
ノートに下敷きを敷くと、字がきれいに書ける。
下敷き
If you put a pad under the notebook page, your handwriting comes out neat.
cf: 下敷きになる means being pinned under something heavy — a separate idiom.
cards.note: Japanese students all use a plastic 下敷き under notebook pages; fanning yourself with one is a classic school memory. 〜を下敷きにする = to base a work on.

cards.g: be pinned under, be crushed under
cards.d: 重い物の下に押さえつけられる。
s: 実は去年の台風で、借りる予定だった倉庫が倒れた大木の下敷きになり、開店は一年遅れたのだという。
下敷きにな
Apparently, in last year's typhoon, the warehouse she'd planned to rent was crushed under a fallen tree, so the opening was delayed a year.
地震で倒れた家具の下敷きになり、けがをした人もいた。
下敷きにな
Some people were injured when they were pinned under furniture toppled by the earthquake.
col: がれきの下敷きになる
cf: 下敷き alone is a desk pad or a model; with になる it usually means being trapped underneath.
cards.note: A stock phrase in disaster news. Figuratively, 〜の下敷きになる can also mean something is the basis of a work, but context makes it clear.

cards.g: trim, prune, clip; cut down (a text)
cards.d: 木の枝や草、髪を切って形を整える。文章を短く削る。
s: 窓の外では、庭師がツツジの植え込みを丸く刈り込んでいた。
刈り込んで
Outside the window, a gardener was trimming the azalea bushes into round shapes.
原稿が長すぎるので、半分ほどに刈り込んでほしい。
刈り込んで
The manuscript is too long, so please cut it down to about half.
cf: 刈る is simply cutting (grass, hair, crops); 刈り込む is trimming to shape or cutting down.
剪定 (せんてい) is horticultural pruning of branches for the plant's health.

cards.d: 答案や演技などを見て、点数をつけること。
s: 私は麺のこしや出汁の味を手帳に殴り書きし、勝手に十点満点で採点していった。
採点
I scrawled notes in my notebook on the noodles' chewiness and the broth, grading each shop out of ten on my own.
先生は週末、百枚近いテストの採点に追われていた。
採点
The teacher spent the weekend buried in grading nearly a hundred tests.
cf: 添削 is correcting someone's writing; 採点 is assigning a score.
評価 is evaluation in general; 採点 is giving points.
cards.note: Also used for judged sports (フィギュアスケートの採点) and karaoke scoring machines.

cards.d: 男子と女子が、同じ学校で一緒に学ぶこと。
s: 私たちは同じ共学の高校に通っていた。
共学
We went to the same co-ed high school.
その女子校は、再来年から共学になるそうだ。
共学
I hear that girls' school is going co-ed the year after next.
cf: Homophone きょうがく: astonishment (驚愕の事実). Completely unrelated.

cards.d: 絵や彫刻、音楽などの作品を生み出す人。
s: 地元の芸術家の作品だと、おかみさんが教えてくれた。
芸術家
The landlady told me it was the work of a local artist.
祖父は、自分は職人であって芸術家ではないと言っていた。
芸術家
My grandfather used to say he was a craftsman, not an artist.
cf: アーティスト is broader and casual, often used for musicians; 芸術家 sounds weightier.
cards.note: 芸術家肌 describes someone with an artistic, unconventional temperament.

title.ja: 人の顔つき — 態度・口癖・オノマトペ
title.en: Faces and attitudes: temperament, slang, onomatopoeia

modules.passageTitle: 銀髪の部長と、なんくるない夜

cards.g: riddle in the 'A is like B — because both Z' pun format
cards.d: 「AとかけてBと解く、その心は」と、しゃれで二つを結ぶ言葉遊び。
s: ギンギンに冷えたビールで乾杯するなり、部長は「では一つ、なぞかけを」と威張りくさった調子で切り出した。
なぞかけ
The moment we'd toasted with ice-cold beer, the boss launched in, in his high-and-mighty tone: "Right, a riddle for you."
落語家の師匠は、客席からお題をもらってその場でなぞかけを披露した。
なぞかけ
The rakugo master took a theme from the audience and came up with a riddle on the spot.
cf: なぞなぞ is any riddle/quiz with an answer; なぞかけ is the specific three-part pun riddle: 「AとかけてBと解く。その心は…」.
cards.note: A traditional performer's word game: the punchline (その心は) is a word that fits both A and B in different senses, e.g. 銀髪 and 年賀状 both need かみ (髪/紙). The source gloss 'telling a riddle' misses this fixed format.

cards.g: pun, wordplay; reading numbers as words (as a mnemonic)
cards.d: 数字や言葉の音を別の言葉に当てはめて、覚えやすくしたり楽しんだりすること。
s: 部長は語呂合わせが大好きで、メールの結びにまで「四六四九（よろしく）」と書いてくる。
語呂合わせ
The boss loves wordplay so much he even signs off his emails with "4649" (yo-ro-shi-ku).
歴史の年号は、語呂合わせで覚えると忘れにくい。
語呂合わせ
Historical dates are hard to forget if you memorise them with number puns.
cf: 駄洒落 is a (groan-worthy) pun told for laughs; 語呂合わせ is matching sounds, typically digits to syllables, often as a memory aid (794 = 鳴くよウグイス平安京).
cards.note: Source gloss 'rhyming game' is misleading: Japanese 語呂合わせ is sound-matching, especially number readings (4=よ/し, 6=ろ, 9=く), not rhyme.

cards.g: it'll all work out; no worries (Okinawan)
cards.d: 沖縄の言葉で、「心配しなくてもなんとかなる」という意味。
s: 沖縄出身の比嘉くんがさりげなく彼女のグラスにお茶を注ぎ、「なんくるないさ」と笑った。
なんくるない
Higa, who's from Okinawa, casually poured some tea into her glass and said with a grin, "Nankurunai sa — it'll be fine."
試験に落ちてしょげている私に、祖母は「なんくるないさー」と笑ってくれた。
なんくるない
When I was down about failing the exam, my grandmother laughed and said, "It'll all work out."
cf: The standard-Japanese equivalent. なんくるない carries a warm Okinawan flavour and is used nationwide as a borrowed catchphrase.
cards.note: Okinawan (Uchinaaguchi), almost always as なんくるないさ(ー). The fuller saying まくとぅそーけー なんくるないさ means roughly 'do what is right and things will work out', so it is not careless optimism. Source gloss 'don't worry, be happy' adjusted.

cards.d: うそやごまかしがないこと。また、本当のことを言えば、という意味。
s: 正直、課の誰もが部長を苦手にしていて、毎週月曜の会議をただじっと耐えている。
正直
Honestly, everyone in the section finds the boss hard to deal with and just silently endures the Monday meetings.
落とし物の財布をすぐに交番に届けるなんて、あの子は本当に正直な子だね。
正直
Taking a lost wallet straight to the police box — that kid is really honest.
cf: 素直 is docile, open-minded, unaffected; 正直 is truthful, not lying.
正直(言って) is a casual personal confession; 率直に言って signals deliberate bluntness, often in discussion.
cards.note: Very common in speech as a bare opener: 正直、… / 正直言って… = 'honestly, …'.

cards.d: 遠慮やかざりをせず、思ったとおりに言えば、という前置き。
s: 「率直に言って、さっきのなぞかけ、僕はけっこう好きでしたよ」
率直に言って
"Frankly, I actually quite liked that riddle earlier."
率直に言って、この計画には無理があると思います。
率直に言って
To be frank, I think this plan is unrealistic.
cf: Near-synonym; 率直 stresses directness of expression, 正直 stresses truthfulness. In meetings 率直に申し上げると is the polite version.
cards.note: Often precedes criticism, but can also introduce a sincere compliment, as in the passage.

cards.d: 思わず笑いたくなるようなおかしさ。ばかばかしく見えること。
s: 会議では威張っている人が、宴会では自分をあえて滑稽に見せるのだから、人はわからない。
滑稽
The man who throws his weight around in meetings deliberately sets out to look comical at parties — people are hard to figure out.
必死に言い訳していた自分の姿を思い出すと、今では滑稽でならない。
滑稽
When I recall how desperately I was making excuses, it seems utterly ridiculous to me now.
cf: おかしい is everyday 'funny/strange'; 滑稽 is more literary and often has a pitying or mocking edge ('laughable').
cards.note: Can be neutral 'humorous' (滑稽本, comic literature) but in modern use often means 'ridiculous'.

cards.g: to scheme, plot, be up to something
cards.d: よくないことやいたずらを、こっそり計画する。
s: どうやら部長は、自分がわざとすべって場を和ませようとたくらんでいたのだ。
たくらん
Apparently the boss had been scheming to break the ice by deliberately flopping.
弟がにやにやしているときは、たいてい何かたくらんでいる。
たくらん
When my little brother is grinning like that, he's usually up to something.
cf: 巧む (たくむ) means to devise artfully and survives mainly in 巧まざる/巧まずして; たくらむ is to scheme.
企てる is a neutral/formal 'plan, attempt'; たくらむ implies secrecy and usually mischief.
cards.note: Kanji 企む. Usually negative or playful-mischievous; used positively only with a wink.

cards.g: broken, intermittent; in fits and starts
cards.d: 続かずに、何度も切れたりつながったりするようす。
s: 彼女は青ざめた顔で、「笑ったの……私だと……思われてないかな」と途切れ途切れにささやいた。
途切れ途切れ
Pale, she whispered haltingly, "Do you think... they think... it was me who laughed?"
電波が悪くて、電話の声が途切れ途切れにしか聞こえない。
途切れ途切れ
The signal is bad, so I can only hear the voice on the phone in bits and pieces.
col: 声が途切れ途切れになる
cf: 断続的 is the written/technical equivalent (断続的な雨); 途切れ途切れ is vivid and everyday, typical of voices, memories, sounds.

cards.d: 親や目上の人の言うことに逆らおうとする態度のようす。
s: 最近の美咲は何かと反抗的で、門限を守れという親の言いつけに背いては母と言い争っている。
反抗的
Lately Misaki has been defiant about everything, ignoring our parents' curfew and arguing with Mum.
上司の指示に反抗的な態度をとれば、評価が下がるのは当然だ。
反抗的
If you're defiant toward your boss's instructions, of course your evaluation will suffer.
cf: 背く is the act of going against a rule or expectation; 反抗的 describes a defiant attitude.

cards.g: even more, all the more; (noun) a single layer
cards.d: 前よりもさらに。程度がもっと強まるようす。
s: 部長の顔つきが一層険しくなったのを見て、僕は思わず目をそらした。
一層
Seeing the boss's expression grow even sterner, I instinctively looked away.
雨が上がると、山の緑が一層鮮やかに見えた。
一層
Once the rain stopped, the green of the mountains looked all the more vivid.
このケーキは、スポンジ一層とクリームだけのシンプルな作りだ。
一層
This cake is a simple affair: just a single layer of sponge and cream.
cf: さらに is the everyday equivalent; 一層 sounds more written and is common in speeches (より一層努力します).
いっそ (sometimes written 一層) means 'rather, might as well' — a different word; that is the source gloss's 'rather, sooner'.
cards.note: The 'rather/sooner' sense in the source gloss belongs to いっそ; for いっそう learn 'even more' first.

cards.g: overly self-conscious; imagining everyone is watching you
cards.d: 人からどう見られているかを、必要以上に気にすること。
s: 隣に座る同期の佐々木さんは、少し自意識過剰なところがある。
自意識過剰
Sasaki, who joined the same year as me and sat next to me, is a bit self-conscious.
誰もあなたの服なんて見てないよ、自意識過剰だって。
自意識過剰
Nobody's looking at your clothes — you're being way too self-conscious.
cf: 自信過剰 is overconfidence — a completely different flaw. 自意識過剰 is worrying about how others see you.
cards.note: Often used as a teasing put-down: 自意識過剰じゃない？ 'Aren't you overthinking it?'

cards.g: to boss everyone around; to lord it over people
cards.d: 周りのだれに対しても、えらそうな態度をとる。
s: 会議では部下の報告を途中で遮り、「つべこべ言うな、結論から話せ」と威張り散らす。
威張り散らす
In meetings he cuts off subordinates' reports halfway and lords it over everyone: "Stop quibbling, give me the conclusion."
昇進したとたんに威張り散らすような人には、誰もついてこない。
威張り散らす
Nobody will follow someone who starts bossing everyone around the moment they're promoted.
cf: 散らす adds 'indiscriminately, all around'; くさる adds the speaker's disgust. Both are critical; 威張りくさる is ruder.
cards.note: Plain 威張る = to act big; 〜散らす intensifies (cf. 怒鳴り散らす).

cards.g: to act all high and mighty (derogatory)
cards.d: ひどくえらそうにする。話し手の強い不快感をこめた言い方。
s: ギンギンに冷えたビールで乾杯するなり、部長は「では一つ、なぞかけを」と威張りくさった調子で切り出した。
威張りくさっ
The moment we'd toasted with ice-cold beer, the boss launched in, in his high-and-mighty tone: "Right, a riddle for you."
あいつ、ちょっと出世したからって威張りくさりやがって。
威張りくさり
Just because he got a little promotion, the guy's acting like he owns the place.
cf: See 威張り散らす: 散らす = toward everyone around; くさる = contemptuous, expresses your own annoyance.
cards.note: 〜くさる (腐る) is a pejorative auxiliary like 〜やがる. Rude: use about third persons, never to someone's face in polite company.

cards.d: 刺激や気配が、強くはっきりと伝わってくるようす。
s: 「部長の視線、さっきからビンビン感じるんだけど」
ビンビン
"I can really feel the boss staring at me — has been for a while."
ライブハウスの低音が、お腹にビンビン響いてきた。
ビンビン
The bass in the club was booming right through my stomach.
col: ビンビン伝わってくる
cf: ビンビン = sensations or vibes hitting you strongly (視線・熱意をビンビン感じる); ギンギン = a state cranked to the max (ギンギンに冷えた, 目がギンギン).
cards.note: Caution: ビンビン is also common slang for an erection, and phrases like 元気ビンビン can sound suggestive. Fine with friends in the 'feel it strongly' sense; avoid in formal settings.

cards.g: intensely, to the max (ice-cold, wide awake, blaring); (vulg.) erect
cards.d: 冷たさや興奮などが、これ以上ないほど強いようす。
s: ギンギンに冷えたビールで乾杯するなり、部長は「では一つ、なぞかけを」と威張りくさった調子で切り出した。
ギンギン
The moment we'd toasted with ice-cold beer, the boss launched in, in his high-and-mighty tone: "Right, a riddle for you."
エナジードリンクを三本も飲んだせいで、目がギンギンで眠れない。
ギンギン
I drank three energy drinks, so I'm wide awake and can't sleep.
cf: See ビンビン. Note ギンギンに冷えたビール is the set phrase; ビンビンに冷えた is not used.
cards.note: Source gloss 'ecstatic; splitting headache' is not the main modern use — corrected. Like ビンビン it can also mean a strong erection, so it is slangy; ギンギンに冷えた is perfectly safe.

cards.d: 食べすぎや飲みすぎをせず、ほどほどにおさえること。
s: 「夜中にお菓子を一袋空けるやつに言われたくないよ。節制って言葉、知ってるか？」
節制
"I don't want to hear it from someone who finishes a whole bag of snacks at midnight. Ever heard of moderation?"
医者に注意されて、父は酒とたばこを節制するようになった。
節制
After the doctor warned him, my father started cutting back on drinking and smoking.
cf: 節約 is saving money/resources; 節制 is restraint of appetites (food, drink, pleasure).
cards.note: 不節制 (lack of moderation) is very common in health contexts: 不節制がたたる.

cards.d: 相手をばかにして、鼻先で笑うこと。また、その笑い。
s: 個室は一瞬静まり返り、隅の方から誰かのせせら笑いが漏れた。
せせら笑い
The private room fell silent for a moment, and someone's sneering laugh slipped out from a corner.
彼の提案は、会議室のせせら笑いにかき消された。
せせら笑い
His proposal was drowned out by sneers around the meeting room.
col: せせら笑いを浮かべる
cf: 苦笑い is a wry, awkward smile at your own or a shared predicament; せせら笑い mocks someone.
冷笑 is the written Sino-Japanese equivalent ('cold sneer').

cards.g: to endure, put up with; to withstand (pressure, heat)
cards.d: 苦しさやつらさを、じっとがまんする。強い力に負けない。
s: 正直、課の誰もが部長を苦手にしていて、毎週月曜の会議をただじっと耐えている。
耐えて
Honestly, everyone in the section finds the boss hard to deal with and just silently endures the Monday meetings.
この建物は、震度七の揺れにも耐えるように設計されている。
耐える
This building is designed to withstand even seismic intensity 7 shaking.
cf: 堪える (たえる) is used for 'be worth / bear to (do)': 見るに堪えない 'unbearable to watch', 鑑賞に堪える. 耐える is endure hardship / withstand force. (堪える read こらえる = hold back.)
cards.note: Takes に for what is endured: 寒さに耐える.

cards.d: 人に知られないように、こっそり行動すること。
s: 部長は数年前から、お忍びで落語教室に通っているのだという。
忍び
Apparently the boss has been secretly attending rakugo classes for several years.
人気俳優がお忍びで訪れたという店には、連日行列ができている。
忍び
There's a queue every day at the shop a famous actor reportedly visited incognito.
戦国時代、忍びの者は敵の城に入り込んで情報を集めた。
忍び
In the Warring States period, ninja slipped into enemy castles to gather intelligence.
cf: 忍者 is the modern word for ninja; 忍び / 忍びの者 is the period term.
cards.note: Modern use is mostly お忍び (celebrities, royalty going incognito) and 忍び足 (tiptoeing).

cards.d: 怖さや気味の悪さで、体が冷たくなるように感じるようす。
s: 幹事としての自分の首が飛ぶ光景を想像して、背筋がぞっとした。
ぞっと
Picturing myself getting the axe as party organiser sent a chill down my spine.
あと一秒遅ければ車にひかれていたと思うと、ぞっとする。
ぞっと
It makes me shudder to think that one second later I'd have been hit by the car.
col: 思い出すだけでぞっとする
cf: Despite looking like a negative, ぞっとしない means 'not appealing', not 'not scary'.

cards.g: not appealing, not very pleasant (not 'not scary')
cards.d: あまり感心しない。気が進まない。
s: ただ、十八番の演歌をあと三曲聞かされるというのは、正直ぞっとしない話だった。
ぞっとしない
Still, being made to listen to three more of his signature enka songs was, honestly, not an appealing prospect.
雨の中を二時間も並ぶなんて、あまりぞっとしないね。
ぞっとしない
Queuing for two hours in the rain doesn't sound very appealing.
cf: ぞっとする = shudder with fear. ぞっとしない comes from an older sense of ぞっと, 'be thrilled/impressed', so it means 'unimpressive, unappealing'.
cards.note: Many natives now misread it as 'not frightening', so in your own speech あまり気が進まない is safer; still learn it for reading.

cards.d: 「〜のように」と同じ意味の、かたい書き言葉。
s: 忘年会の当日、部長は王様のごとく個室の上座に陣取った。
ごとく
On the day of the year-end party, the boss installed himself in the seat of honour like a king.
彼は水を得た魚のごとく、新しい職場で生き生きと働いている。
ごとく
Like a fish returned to water, he's thriving at his new workplace.
cf: ように is the everyday form; ごとく (如く) is literary and adds weight or irony.
cards.note: Kanji 如く. Related forms: ごとき (attributive: 神のごとき力; self-deprecating 私ごとき) and ごとし (sentence-final, classical).

cards.g: still, even more; (in writing) furthermore, note that…
cards.d: 前よりさらに。また、あとから付け加えて言うときの言葉。
s: なお、来年の忘年会の幹事も僕に決まったことを、ここに書き添えておく。
なお
I should add, for the record, that I've also been made organiser of next year's party.
何度注意されても、彼はなお同じミスを繰り返した。
なお
No matter how often he was warned, he still kept making the same mistake.
返事は早ければ早いほど、なおありがたいです。
なお
The sooner you reply, the better still.
cf: なお adds a supplementary note or means 'still/more'; なおかつ joins two qualities: 'and also / and yet'.
cards.note: Kanji 尚. Sentence-initial なお、… is the standard way to add a footnote-like remark in notices, emails and articles.

cards.g: and moreover, and also; and yet, even so
cards.d: その上さらに。また、それでもまだ。
s: 部長は歌もうまく、なおかつ曲紹介まで語呂合わせで決めてくる。
なおかつ
The boss sings well, and on top of that he nails every song intro with a pun.
安くて、なおかつ栄養のある食事を毎日作るのは難しい。
なおかつ
It's hard to cook meals every day that are cheap and nutritious as well.
cf: かつ (且つ) is the stiffer 'and also'; なおかつ adds emphasis ('and on top of that').
cards.note: Kanji 尚且つ. The 'and yet' sense appears in 負けてもなおかつ挑み続ける.

cards.g: to underestimate, make light of; to look down on
cards.d: 相手の力を低く見て、軽くあつかう。
s: 「若いからって部長を侮るなよ。あの人、根に持つタイプだから」と先輩に脅された。
侮る
"Don't take the boss lightly just because you're young — he holds grudges," a senior warned me.
相手は無名のチームだが、決して侮れない実力を持っている。
侮れ
Our opponents are an unknown team, but they're by no means to be underestimated.
cf: 見くびる is more colloquial; 侮る is slightly more formal and also covers contempt.
軽蔑 is moral contempt; 侮る is mainly underestimating someone's ability.
cards.note: The potential negative 侮れない ('formidable, not to be underestimated') is extremely common in reviews and sports.

cards.d: ひどくおどろくこと。
s: 驚愕する僕たちに、総務の古株の女性がこっそり教えてくれた。
驚愕
Seeing us stunned, a long-serving woman from General Affairs quietly filled us in.
事件の真相が明らかになり、町じゅうが驚愕した。
驚愕
When the truth of the case came out, the whole town was stunned.
cf: Homophone: 共学 (きょうがく) is co-education (男女共学).
驚嘆 is astonished admiration; 驚愕 is shock, often unpleasant.
cards.note: Common in headlines and ads (驚愕の新事実!) — stronger than 驚く.

cards.d: したい放題にふるまって、だらしなく暮らすこと。
s: 「放逸な暮らしをしていると、ろくな大人にならないよ」というのが、古風な言い回しを好む母の口癖だ。
放逸
"Live a dissolute life and you'll never amount to anything" — that's a favourite line of my mother, who loves old-fashioned expressions.
若き日の放逸な生活を、その作家は晩年になって深く悔いた。
放逸
In his later years the writer deeply regretted the dissipated life of his youth.
cf: 放蕩 (ほうとう) is the more common word for dissipation, especially squandering money on pleasure.
放埒 (ほうらつ) is a close literary synonym: unrestrained, dissolute.
cards.note: Rare and literary; you'll meet it in essays and Buddhist texts more than in speech.

cards.d: 顔の形やようす。また、そのときの表情。
s: 部長の顔つきが一層険しくなったのを見て、僕は思わず目をそらした。
顔つき
Seeing the boss's expression grow even sterner, I instinctively looked away.
彼は真剣な顔つきで、医者の説明に耳を傾けていた。
顔つき
He listened to the doctor's explanation with a serious look on his face.
cf: 表情 is the neutral word for expression; 顔つき also covers one's general features and the vibe a face gives off.
目つき is the look in someone's eyes (鋭い目つき).
